items.title: Lakers, Walker Kessler put undefeated start up against Jazz
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Walker Kessler is thriving after two games with the Los Angeles Lakers and will get a chance to show off his form against his former team, the Utah Jazz, on Sunday at Salt Lake City.
items.body:
Walker Kessler is thriving after two games with the Los Angeles Lakers and will get a chance to show off his form against his former team, the Utah Jazz, on Sunday at Salt Lake City.
A shakeup in the starting lineup got the Jazz in the win column Friday and may prove beneficial going forward as Utah continues to search for a flow following Kessler's departure.
The Jazz edged the New Orleans Pelicans 120-119 on Friday after Jaxson Hayes gave the Jazz a spark off the bench. Hayes, who played for the Lakers the past three seasons, started Utah's season-opening loss at Memphis on Wednesday before moving to the second unit against the Pelicans.
Hayes scored 17 points with five rebounds in 26 minutes and defended the rim well while hitting big baskets to key a fourth-quarter rally.
"I think Jaxson at the five creates a different set of matchups for us offensively, which will maybe have us see a few different coverages, potentially give us some more space with that first group," Jazz coach Will Hardy said.
Utah did struggle to play a consistent 48 minutes. A poor third quarter nearly doomed the effort as the Jazz blew a 15-point lead while committing eight turnovers and seven fouls in the period. The Pelicans also shot 60.9% from the floor in the third quarter.
Jaren Jackson Jr., who finished with a team-high 24 points and 10 rebounds, stepped up in the fourth quarter along with Hayes to prevent an 0-2 start.
Now comes the reunion with Kessler after the Jazz dealt the big man to Los Angeles over the summer in exchange for a pair of unprotected first-round draft picks and two first-round pick swaps.
It was a steep price tag for Kessler, who played only five games last season because of a shoulder injury. The Lakers saw him as an essential component of their future as they sought to retool their roster around Luka Doncic after LeBron James' departure.
So far, Kessler has lived up to expectations.
Kessler has averaged 24 points on 84.6% shooting, 8.5 rebounds, and four blocks in his first two games with the Lakers. He had 22 points, six blocks, and three steals to help lead the Lakers to a 125-117 victory over the Clippers -- their ninth win in 13 meetings with their crosstown rivals.
Kessler became the eighth Laker player all time to tally six blocks and three steals in a single game.
"It's kind of crazy that there have been seven guys who have done it before," Kessler said. "I know there's some absolute legends in the Lakers franchise -- definitely an honor."
The Lakers pulled away from the Clippers in the third quarter after a tight first half due to Kessler's defensive dominance.
"(He) really was a huge spark for us getting this win," Lakers head coach JJ Redick said. "There were multiple times where it felt like they had a layup and he either came over and blocked the shot or created an altered shot."
Los Angeles swept the season series against Utah last season by winning all four games. The Lakers are 7-1 against the Jazz over the past two seasons.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US administrations asked Musk to switch Starlink on or off in multiple countries: Report
items.author: Livemint
items.summary: Biden and Trump governments sought SpaceX's help for internet access in Iran and military communications in Ukraine
items.body: The administrations of former US President Joe Biden and current President Donald Trump have repeatedly asked Elon Musk's SpaceX to activate or restrict its Starlink satellite internet service in different countries, highlighting Washington's growing reliance on private technology companies to implement foreign policy objectives, according to a Reuters report citing six former senior US officials.The requests, made before the recent restrictions on Ukraine's military access to SpaceX satellite communications, included disabling Starlink to prevent Iran-backed militias in Yemen and Lebanon from using the service and activating it to provide internet access in Iran and Ukraine, Reuters reported.During Biden's presidency, US officials sought to restrict the service's availability to certain militant groups while also requesting its activation to support internet access in Iran and military communications in Ukraine, four former officials told Reuters.The Trump administration similarly asked Musk, SpaceX's chief executive, tomake Starlink available in Iran following US-Israeli strikes in 2025 and 2026. The objective was to strengthen internet connectivity and communications for anti-government protesters, the report said.Ukraine restrictions raise questions over US-Musk tiesThe recent restrictions on Ukraine's access to SpaceX satellite services have renewed concerns about the relationship between the US government and Musk, whose company operates satellite communication systems considered important to the US military and its allies.The earlier requests by both administrations illustrate how Washington has increasingly depended on a private company to support diplomatic, political and military objectives abroad.The restrictions affecting Ukraine have also caused concern among European officials, some of whom argue that Europe needs to develop independent military satellite communication capabilities.European governments face a significant challenge because there is currently no readily available alternative that can immediately match SpaceX's capabilities, according to the report.Zelenskiy says restrictions affected military dronesUkrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said last week that access to Starshield, SpaceX's military-focused satellite communication system, had been deliberately restricted, affecting the performance of Ukrainian military drones.He also said that Starlink connection speeds had been reduced. Ukraine relies on the service for several military operations, including frontline communications and defence against Russian missile attacks.Musk said in a social media post earlier this week: “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately (by the president of the United States).”Reuters previously reported that the order to restrict Starshield's operations in Ukraine originated within the White House. The Trump administration has acknowledged the slowdown but has not confirmed whether it issued the order.The developments have raised questions about the extent to which a private technology provider can influence the communications capabilities of a country engaged in a war.Starlink remains critical to Ukraine's battlefield operationsStarlink has become a vital communication network for Ukrainian forces, connecting military units operating along the frontline. Ukrainian personnel have said there is currently no rival offering comparable capabilities.The service has helped maintain communications in areas where conventional networks have been damaged or disrupted by fighting.Starshield receivers, designed for military applications, are also used in Ukrainian drones as guidance systems and to maintain communication links with remote pilots. These systems support drone operations, including missions deep behind Russian lines within Ukraine. Their resistance to radio-frequency jamming has made them particularly valuable in a battlefield environment where electronic warfare is widespread.Europe considers alternatives to private satellite networksThe latest developments have intensified debate over the strategic risks of relying on privately owned satellite infrastructure for national security and military operations.For Ukraine, any disruption to satellite connectivity could affect coordination between military units and the operation of drones. For European governments, the episode has underscored the need to strengthen independent defence communications infrastructure.The repeated requests by successive US administrations also demonstrate how satellite internet services have become instruments of international policy, with decisions by a private company potentially carrying consequences for governments, armed forces and civilian populations.

items.title: Gunmen kill at least 40 people in northeastern Nigeria, Amnesty International says
items.author: Ahmed Kingimi, Adewale Kolawole
items.creator: Ahmed Kingimi, Adewale Kolawole
items.summary: Gunmen killed at least 40 people in an attack on a village in Nigeria's northeastern Taraba state on Friday afternoon, Amnesty International said.
items.body:
Gunmen killed at least 40 people in an attack on a village in Nigeria's northeastern Taraba state on Friday afternoon, Amnesty International said.
A large group of gunmen carried out the attack on Binnari village, police said in a statement on Saturday
Amnesty International said in a statement that while police had earlier confirmed the killing of 10 people, more bodies were recovered later on Saturday
The attackers invaded the village with heavy gunfire and looted food items from shops, police said
Northern Nigeria has experienced a surge in [USN:L8N45T13I TEXT:"attacks"] by heavily armed criminal gangs, known locally as bandits, who raid villages, abduct residents for ransom and steal livestock

items.title: Cooper Flagg (shoulder) out vs. Spurs, to be reevaluated next week
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dallas Mavericks star Cooper Flagg will miss Saturday's home game against the San Antonio Spurs because of a mild left shoulder sprain.
items.body:
Dallas Mavericks star Cooper Flagg will miss Saturday's home game against the San Antonio Spurs because of a mild left shoulder sprain.
Flagg, last season's NBA Rookie of the Year, left the Mavericks' 121-105 victory over the Indiana Pacers on Friday following a hard collision with Aaron Nesmith one minute before halftime. Alone on a fastbreak, Flagg went up for a two-handed dunk when Nesmith committed a flagrant foul.
Mavericks head coach Dusty May said postgame that Flagg was in "good spirits" in the locker room. The 19-year-old, who scored 14 points with six assists in 17 minutes, underwent an MRI on Saturday that diagnosed the injury and he will be reevaluated next week.
Flagg delivered 32 points, five rebounds, two assists, three steals and one block in his lone full game this season, a 128-110 loss to the Houston Rockets on Wednesday.
After playing host to the Spurs, Dallas faces the Miami Heat on the road Monday before returning home for six of its next seven games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Hamilton fastest to complete Ferrari's US Grand Prix practice sweep
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton was fastest for Ferrari in final practice for the US Grand Prix on Saturday after teammate Charles Leclerc led Friday's two sessions at Austin's Circuit of the Americas.
items.body:
Lewis Hamilton was fastest for Ferrari in final practice for the US Grand Prix on Saturday after teammate Charles Leclerc [USN:L6N4691A0 TEXT:"led Friday's two sessions"] at Austin's Circuit of the Americas.
The seven-time world champion had trailed Leclerc a day earlier, complaining about the bumps and the set-up direction of his upgraded car, but he seemed to have got it back to what he wanted.
The 41-year-old lapped in a best time of one minute 34.893 seconds, 0.168 quicker than Red Bull rival Max Verstappen and 0.234 faster than Leclerc, to complete the Ferrari practice sweep ahead of Saturday's qualifying, with Ferrari chasing a first pole of 2026.
"Ferrari looks to be very strong. They have some nice upgrades, and Red Bull. It looks to me like Ferrari might be the team to beat this weekend," said McLaren boss Zak Brown.
Leclerc would have been top, had he not had his best lap deleted for exceeding track limits at Turn Nine, while Hamilton also had to take evasive action on a late fast lap to avoid Gabriel Bortoleto's slow Audi ahead of him.
Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who can take the title on Sunday if he wins and other results go his way, was fifth fastest -- also losing a lap time due to track limits -- with closest rival and teammate George Russell fourth.
Antonelli leads Russell by 102 points with five races remaining after Austin, unless the last two in the Middle East have to be cancelled due to conflict in the region.
Four-time world champion Verstappen has won the last two races in Malaysia and Singapore and was also the winner from pole in Austin last season.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri was sixth fastest, with teammate and reigning champion Lando Norris eighth. Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was sandwiched between the pair in seventh.
Alpine's Pierre Gasly and Red Bull's Isack Hadjar completed the top 10 on the timesheets.

items.title: Burnley dismiss coach Hayen after 14 games
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Burnley have parted ways with head coach Nicky Hayen after just 14 matches, the Championship club said on Saturday, following a poor start to the season.
items.body:
Burnley have parted ways with head coach Nicky Hayen after just 14 matches, the Championship club said on Saturday, following a poor start to the season.
The 46-year-old Belgian's final game in charge was Saturday's 4-1 defeat at Lincoln City, a result that extended Burnley's struggles and left them 22nd in the table. Burnley have won only once in their last 12 league matches.
"Burnley Football Club has dismissed head coach Nicky Hayen with immediate effect. The Board has taken the decision following a disappointing start to the Championship season," the club said in a statement.
Hayen was appointed on a [USN:L6N43C0YF TEXT:"three-year deal in the summer"], replacing Scott Parker, who left by mutual consent in April after Burnley's relegation from the Premier League was confirmed, with the club dropping into the Championship for the third time in five seasons
Hayen was named caretaker manager of Club Brugge in March 2024. He guided the team to the 2023-24 Belgian Pro League title and the Champions League last 16 the following season.
After being appointed on a permanent basis in June 2024, he also won the Belgian Cup and Belgian Super Cup and was named Belgium's Coach of the Year in 2024.

items.title: Roma rally to draw 3-3 at Napoli as Como keep on winning
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Napoli midfielder Frank Anguissa scored with a superb overhead kick but AS Roma twice came from behind to secure a 3-3 draw in a pulsating Serie A clash in Naples, while Como kept up their good form with a 2-0 home win against Sassuolo.
items.body:
Napoli midfielder Frank Anguissa scored with a superb overhead kick but AS Roma twice came from behind to secure a 3-3 draw in a pulsating Serie A clash in Naples, while Como kept up their good form with a 2-0 home win against Sassuolo.
Roma could have gone top of the table with victory but, having trailed 2-0 and then 3-2 late on, will be pleased with a point as they also preserved their 15-game unbeaten run in Serie A that dates back to April.
They are in third place with 18 points from eight games, one point behind leaders Inter Milan and Lazio, who have each played a game fewer.
Napoli will be disappointed not to have managed the game better as Anguissa’s spectacular overhead kick gave them the lead and Scott McTominay doubled the advantage.
At that stage they were cruising, but two goals in four minutes from Matias Soule and Leonardo Balerdi drew Roma level.
When McTominay added his second in the closing stages the momentum swung back in Napoli’s favour, but Balerdi headed an equaliser for Roma with a minute remaining.
Two second-half goals from Anastasios Douvikas took Como to victory against Sassuolo as the Greek striker continued his red-hot form.
He has scored five goals in his last four games in all competitions and provided two clinical finishes in the box as Como climbed to fourth place with 17 points from their eight games. Sassuolo are in 14th.
"He (Douvikas) is growing in a way that could make him a very, very important centre-forward," Como coach Cesc Fabregas said. "In the last three years he has been one of those signings that has given a lot of satisfaction."
Bologna were 2-0 winners at Cagliari as they claimed their second victory of the season.
Defender Nicolo Casale scored his first goal in almost four years to give Bologna the lead before Federico Bernardeschi doubled the advantage for the visitors.
"It was a very difficult game on a tough pitch," Bernardeschi said. "These games are won with character. Cagliari made us suffer, but in the second half we reacted well."

items.title: Blackhawks, Panthers look to correct mistakes ahead of Sunday matinee
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Start strong, finish feebly.
items.body:
Start strong, finish feebly.
The Chicago Blackhawks have followed that pattern more often than they'd prefer over the first 10 games of the season.
A Sunday matinee against the visiting Florida Panthers offers the next chance for Chicago to correct.
"I still like our team a lot," Blackhawks coach Jeff Blashill said. "We haven't had a full group yet. I look forward to that day when we have our full group. We're 3-7, so that's way far off from where we want to be. I don't think we're far off from it clicking and turning the other way, but we got to make it happen. ... It'll be a broken record until we fix it."
Chicago fell to 2-3-0 on a seven-game homestand with Friday's 4-1 loss to the Montreal Canadiens.
Skating without defenseman Bowen Byram (upper body) and forward Andrew Mangiapane, who earlier in the day was activated from injured reserve, the Blackhawks still built early momentum.
Captain Connor Bedard scored 4:23 into the game and Jordan Greenway hit the post later in the first period. But the Blackhawks conceded a goal at 17:29 to begin a string of four straight Montreal tallies to close the game.
In the third, the Blackhawks needed 8:45 to register their first shot on goal.
"We need to have some conversations ... and figure out how we can be better, because clearly (what we're doing is) not good enough," defenseman Ian Cole said. "We start the game well, come out looking good, flying, speeding fast -- that's great, but ultimately they take it to us."
Meanwhile, slumping Florida has allowed nine successive goals since Brady Tkachuk scored midway through the first period of Wednesday's visit to Ottawa, where Tkachuk played for eight seasons.
The Senators rallied for a 5-1 victory, then the host Pittsburgh Penguins prevailed 4-0 over the Panthers on Thursday. Sam Reinhart had six shots and Sam Bennett four but the Panthers couldn't solve Penguins goaltender Arturs Silovs as Florida was shut out for the first time this season.
"I don't know if we're on the spectrum of arrogance and softness that I've allowed to creep into our game," Panthers coach Paul Maurice said. "I'm going to find that out here in a couple of days. ... I've got to figure out where it's coming from. I think it's coming from me. So, we've got a good 48 hours to grind on that and come up with an answer.
"I just need to get their attention."
Added Matthew Tkachuk: "This stuff just can't happen. It's not even how we're losing, it's the way we're playing. It's something that we're going to have to fix in here."
Although the lopsided losses have felt repetitive, the Panthers nonetheless were part of league history Thursday behind goaltender Cooper Black. The 6-foot-9 rookie became the tallest netminder to appear in the NHL, making 17 saves.
Defenseman Gustav Forsling left the game late in the third period after being hit in the face by a puck.
Akira Schmid is set to start in net, Maurice said Saturday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump administration demands county election officials identify noncitizen voters in California, report says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Less than two weeks before US midterm elections, the Department of Justice has warned election officials across California that they could be targets of federal "scrutiny" if they refuse to help identify suspected noncitizens on voter rolls and set aside their mail ballots pending citizenship checks, the New York Times reported.
items.body:
Less than two weeks before US midterm elections, the Department of Justice has warned election officials across California that they could be targets of federal "scrutiny" if they refuse to help identify suspected noncitizens on voter rolls and set aside their mail ballots pending citizenship checks, the New York Times reported.
According to the letters sent on Friday to all 58 California counties, local officials were given 48 hours to help determine the citizenship status of individuals on federal government lists, the Times wrote.
The letters warned counties they could face "significant federal scrutiny" if they failed to comply.
According to the Times, the letters included lists of people whom the Justice Department believes to be illegally registered to vote and described them as a subset of the 20,000 people throughout California it identified last week as possible noncitizens who may have received ballots.
For those whose "citizenship status cannot be confirmed, we request that you immediately instruct the appropriate elections official to segregate — not cancel — those individuals' vote-by-mail ballots until their citizenship status can be determined," it quoted the letter as saying.
The Justice Department and the California attorney general's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
In the run-up to next month's midterm elections, the Justice Department has ramped up prosecutions of people accused of illegally voting while not holding US citizenship.
The White House has also pushed federal agencies to accelerate their review of at least 47 state voter rolls obtained by the Department of Homeland Security, according to an internal email seen by Reuters.
On October 16, the DOJ warned Los Angeles County and California election officials they could be liable as [USN:L1N46212B TEXT:"abettors of a federal crime"] if they count mail ballots returned by more than 20,000 people the Trump administration says are probably noncitizens.
California officials have rejected the moves, saying the federal government has not provided sufficient information about how it identified the alleged noncitizens.
California Secretary of State Shirley Weber has accused the administration of attempting to unlawfully access protected voter data and purge voter rolls, saying such efforts undermine confidence in elections.
items.raw_description: Less than two weeks before US midterm elections, the Department of Justice has warned election officials across California that they could be targets of federal "scrutiny" if they refuse to help identify suspected noncitizens on voter rolls and set aside their mail ballots pending citizenship checks, the New York Times reported.

items.title: Protests sweep Italian cities amid heavy security presence, some violence reported
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Protests against war and rising living costs took place in major Italian cities on Saturday, with some incidents of violence, a week after unrest erupted across the country.
items.body:
Protests against war and rising living costs took place in major Italian cities on Saturday, with some incidents of violence, a week after unrest erupted across the country.
Authorities deployed a heavy police presence and many shops closed as a precaution against possible damage.
The demonstrations, [USN:L8N4650S6 TEXT:"which followed clashes last weekend"] in which protesters fought with police, looted shops and vandalised property, were violent in Turin, Rome and Bologna, with clashes between officers and demonstrators. They were largely peaceful in Milan.
Reuters witnesses did not observe any shops being looted or property vandalised.
After calls for further demonstrations circulated on social media this week, authorities made extensive security arrangements and deployed large numbers of police officers to prevent a repeat of last weekend's violence.
Earlier on Saturday, Italian police said they had detained a person allegedly linked to organising the "October 17 Movement" — last weekend's protests — and had taken them to police headquarters in Milan for questioning.

items.title: Merz hace un llamamiento a la unidad, advierte de las amenazas a las que se enfrenta Alemania
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El canciller Friedrich Merz hizo un llamamiento el sábado a la unidad en su coalición, y afirmó que Alemania se enfrentaba a amenazas crecientes por parte de extremistas políticos y a lo que describió como esfuerzos diarios de Rusia por desestabilizar el país.
items.body:
El canciller Friedrich Merz hizo un llamamiento el sábado a la unidad en su coalición, y afirmó que Alemania se enfrentaba a amenazas crecientes por parte de extremistas políticos y a lo que describió como esfuerzos diarios de Rusia por desestabilizar el país.
En su intervención en una conferencia de la Unión Social Cristiana (CSU), el partido hermano bávaro de su partido conservador, la Unión Demócrata Cristiana (CDU), Merz afirmó que Alemania se enfrenta a "retos extraordinariamente graves".
"¿Cómo salvaguardamos nuestra libertad y nuestra seguridad en Europa, ante las crecientes amenazas de los extremistas internos y de las potencias extranjeras?", preguntó, y añadió que Rusia trata de "desestabilizar a Alemania a diario".
Las relaciones entre Berlín y Moscú han caído a su nivel más bajo desde la Guerra Fría tras la invasión rusa de Ucrania en 2022, pero Moscú rechaza las acusaciones de que esté llevando a cabo una campaña híbrida contra Alemania y otros países europeos.
Las declaraciones de Merz se producen tras semanas de tensión con la coalición gobernante, a raíz de las contundentes derrotas en las elecciones regionales del este de Alemania, donde el partido de extrema derecha Alternativa para Alemania (AfD) quedó en primer lugar en dos estados y el Partido de Izquierda, de extrema izquierda, se impuso en Berlín.
Los índices de popularidad de Merz han caído a mínimos históricos, mientras que han surgido tensiones tanto entre los socios de la coalición como entre la CDU y la CSU.

items.title: 76ers' LeBron James (back management) out vs. visiting Bucks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia 76ers star LeBron James has been ruled out of Saturday's game against the visiting Milwaukee Bucks because of lower back management.
items.body:
Philadelphia 76ers star LeBron James has been ruled out of Saturday's game against the visiting Milwaukee Bucks because of lower back management.
The 41-year-old has been managing sciatica since the start of the 2025-26 season and will have the night off, according to the NBA's official injury report.
James is averaging 33.5 minutes, 15.5 points, 9.5 rebounds and 6.0 assists through two games with his new team. The 2-0 76ers defeated the defending champion New York Knicks 106-100 on Tuesday before erasing a 29-point deficit against the Cleveland Cavaliers for a 114-106 victory Thursday.
Dominick Barlow (back), Tacko Fall (quad), and Ariel Hukporti (Achilles) are also out Saturday in Philadelphia's second game of an early-season three-game homestand.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Mike Ashley toma el control de Hugo Boss con una participación superior al 50%
items.author: Sonja Wind, Maddie Parker
items.summary: Bloomberg — Frasers Group Plc informó que tomó el control de Hugo Boss AG, al elevar su participación al 50,08% y convertir a la marca alemana de indumentaria en una filial del imperio minorista del ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Frasers Group Plc informó que tomó el control de Hugo Boss AG, al elevar su participación al 50,08% y convertir a la marca alemana de indumentaria en una filial del imperio minorista del multimillonario británico Mike Ashley. Con una nueva compra de acciones de Boss, Frasers elevó su participación al 50,08%, informó la compañía británica en un comunicado el viernes. Frasers tenía previamente alrededor del 48%, luego de que una oferta pública inicial de adquisición no alcanzara su objetivo. La compañía británica, propietaria de Sports Direct, Flannels y House of Fraser, incrementó su participación en Boss durante los últimos meses y persistió en su búsqueda de una posición de control. El mes pasado, Frasers reforzó su influencia sobre Boss cuando Michael Murray, director ejecutivo de la compañía alemana y yerno de Ashley, fue nombrado presidente del directorio. VER MÁS: El otro éxito del Mundial: la camisa Hugo Boss de Mauricio Pochettino, director técnico de EE.UU., arrasa en ventas Frasers tiene fama de acumular participaciones en empresas minoristas europeas y luego buscar cambios, y ha ampliado progresivamente su participación en Boss desde que invirtió por primera vez en la marca en 2020. En junio, Frasers lanzó una oferta de adquisición de 38 euros por acción, aunque Boss recomendó a sus accionistas que no la aceptaran, al argumentar que el precio infravaloraba a la compañía. La firma alemana también puso fin anticipadamente a un programa de recompra de acciones, lo que eliminó una de las vías por las que Frasers podría haber elevado su participación por encima del 50% sin comprar acciones adicionales. En la última operación, Frasers informó que adquirió otras 198.666 acciones de Boss al precio de la oferta anterior, por un total de 7,63 millones de euros (US$8,6 millones). Las acciones de Boss cerraron el viernes a 38,41 euros, lo que le otorgó a la compañía una capitalización bursátil de algo más de 2.600 millones de euros. Las ganancias de Boss se consolidarán en las cuentas de Frasers y la minorista alemana pasará a ser una filial, informó la compañía británica. Boss, conocida por sus trajes y ropa interior de alta gama, atraviesa un segundo plan de recuperación bajo la dirección ejecutiva de Daniel Grieder. En los últimos años, Frasers ha ampliado su presencia en el segmento del lujo mediante la adquisición de participaciones en las marcas británicas Mulberry y Burberry, además de comprar en agosto la histórica cadena de tiendas departamentales de lujo Harvey Nichols, que se encontraba bajo administración concursal. VER MÁS: Spotify llega a 788 millones de usuarios, aunque sus ingresos decepcionan a Wall Street Murray afirmó en septiembre que veía un “potencial significativo aún sin explotar” en Boss y señaló que su objetivo era crear “valor sostenible para todos los accionistas y las partes interesadas”. Ese mismo mes, Stephan Sturm dejó la presidencia del consejo de supervisión de Boss, después de que la compañía británica cuestionara reiteradamente su respaldo a él. El aumento de la participación de Frasers no implica cambios significativos en términos de influencia ni en las operaciones cotidianas de Boss, dijo por teléfono un portavoz de la compañía alemana. Frasers declinó hacer comentarios sobre sus planes para la marca alemana más allá de lo informado en su comunicado. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Violência aumenta em Paris após protestos majoritariamente pacíficos em toda a França
items.author: Juliette Jabkhiro, Yann Tessier, Crispian Balmer
items.creator: Juliette Jabkhiro, Yann Tessier, Crispian Balmer
items.summary: Centenas de milhares de manifestantes marcharam pela França neste sábado, com atos que foram em grande parte pacíficos dando lugar a confrontos em Paris e Marselha ao cair da noite, apesar de uma ampla operação de segurança destinada a evitar a repetição da violência registrada na semana passada.
items.body:
Centenas de milhares de manifestantes marcharam pela França neste sábado, com atos que foram em grande parte pacíficos dando lugar a confrontos em Paris e Marselha ao cair da noite, apesar de uma ampla operação de segurança destinada a evitar a repetição da violência registrada na semana passada.
O Ministério do Interior informou que 410 mil pessoas participaram dos protestos em todo o país, embora os sindicatos afirmem que o número real tenha sido o dobro.
A principal manifestação ocorreu em Paris, onde cerca de 110 mil pessoas marcharam na região sudeste da capital, denunciando o aumento do custo de vida e o crescimento da desigualdade.
O clima se deteriorou rapidamente após o término do ato. A polícia de choque disparou gás lacrimogêneo e utilizou canhões de água para dispersar um grupo de cerca de 500 jovens encapuzados que atiravam pedras contra os agentes, informou uma autoridade de segurança.
Na segunda maior cidade da França, Marselha, jovens arrastaram grandes chapas metálicas para bloquear uma rua, atearam fogo a lixeiras e lançaram pedras e garrafas contra a polícia de choque.
Os confrontos prosseguiram após o pôr do sol e a polícia informou que duas joalherias foram saqueadas.
Também houve confrontos em Lyon, Bordeaux e Grenoble, enquanto a polícia lançou sucessivas cargas de gás lacrimogêneo contra manifestantes em Clermont-Ferrand, Lille, Nantes e Nice.
Ainda assim, a violência foi menos intensa do que há uma semana, quando saqueadores e vândalos promoveram uma onda de destruição em várias cidades francesas.
BUSCAS PREVENTIVAS As autoridades mobilizaram 70 mil policiais e gendarmes, 10 mil a mais do que uma semana antes, após admitirem que haviam subestimado a dimensão dos distúrbios de 17 de outubro.
"Temos que ser extremamente, extremamente reativos", disse o ministro do Interior, Laurent Nunez, aos jornalistas neste sábado, acusando ativistas de extrema esquerda e grupos criminosos de tentar fomentar a violência.
Grande parte do centro de Paris assumiu a aparência de uma cidade em confinamento, com comerciantes protegendo vitrines com tapumes, museus fechando as portas e mais de 20 estações de metrô sendo fechadas.
Entidades empresariais recomendaram que os varejistas permanecessem fechados após milhares de lojas e estabelecimentos comerciais terem sido danificados ou saqueados em toda a França no fim de semana passado.
Diversas das instituições culturais mais conhecidas da capital, incluindo o Louvre, o Museu d'Orsay e a Ópera de Paris, fecharam durante o dia por precaução, deixando turistas frustrados.
PROTESTOS SE ESPALHAM PELA EUROPA A onda de protestos começou com pequenas manifestações estudantis nos arredores de Paris no mês passado para denunciar as condições nas escolas. Após se transformar em um movimento mais amplo contra a situação econômica da França, também levou manifestantes às ruas de países vizinhos.
Neste sábado, a polícia belga utilizou gás lacrimogêneo e spray de pimenta em confrontos com manifestantes antigoverno em Bruxelas, enquanto protestos ocorreram em várias cidades italianas pelo segundo fim de semana consecutivo.
Líderes da esquerda francesa criticaram a decisão do governo de limitar o número de manifestações autorizadas em muitas cidades, bem como uma decisão de última hora de transferir o ato de Paris para a periferia sudeste da capital.
O líder da esquerda radical Jean-Luc Mélenchon, que participou da manifestação em Paris, elogiou o que chamou de uma "magnífica demonstração de massa de disciplina coletiva e autocontenção".
Ele previu que os protestos continuarão até que o presidente Emmanuel Macron, cujo mandato termina no próximo ano, enfrente o mal-estar social na França, uma das nações mais ricas do mundo, mas com uma dívida crescente que tem alarmado investidores.
"Dada a situação atual, acho que ele acabará entendendo que isso vai acontecer novamente toda semana. Ainda há tempo para (Macron) ceder. Depois disso, a única coisa que lhe restará será a porta de saída", disse Mélenchon a jornalistas.
(Reportagem de Crispian Balmer, Bertrand Boucey, Yann Tessier, Alessandro Parodi em Paris e Elizabeth Pineau em Orléans)

items.title: Policía albanesa lanza gases lacrimógenos mientras protestas contra el Gobierno se vuelven violentas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La policía antidisturbios albanesa utilizó gases lacrimógenos, cañones de agua y balas de goma para dispersar el sábado a los manifestantes que lanzaron piedras contra los agentes y provocaron un incendio en la puerta del Ministerio de Agricultura en la capital.
items.body:
La policía antidisturbios albanesa utilizó gases lacrimógenos, cañones de agua y balas de goma para dispersar el sábado a los manifestantes que lanzaron piedras contra los agentes y provocaron un incendio en la puerta del Ministerio de Agricultura en la capital.
Las manifestaciones lideradas por estudiantes, avivadas por la indignación ante la supuesta corrupción del Gobierno, la falta de empleo y el bajo nivel educativo, han invadido el centro de Tirana y se han extendido a otras ciudades este mes.
Los manifestantes, que exigen la dimisión del primer ministro Edi Rama, han incendiado edificios gubernamentales y bancos, han destrozado escaparates y han arrancado adoquines para lanzárselos a la policía.
Los disturbios, que se producen tras meses de protestas en su mayoría pacíficas contra un lujoso proyecto urbanístico costero respaldado por el yerno de Donald Trump, Jared Kushner, suponen el mayor desafío hasta la fecha para Rama, que gobierna desde 2013 y ganó un cuarto mandato el año pasado.
Los manifestantes se reunieron frente al Ministerio de Educación y lanzaron piedras y rocas contra la policía, que los hizo retroceder y dispersarse por varios puntos de la ciudad.

items.title: Lula y Flávio discrepan sobre tasas de interés, deuda e impuestos en el último debate
items.author: Filipe Serrano (ES)
items.summary: Lula defendió el crecimiento para reducir la deuda pública, mientras que Flávio Bolsonaro culpó al gasto estatal por las altas tasas y prometió refinanciar las deudas de las familias.
items.body: A dos días de la segunda vuelta, los candidatos dedicaron parte del debate en Globo a las acusaciones. En sus propuestas, Lula defendió el crecimiento como vía para reducir la deuda, mientras que Flávio atribuyó las tasas de interés al gasto público y prometió refinanciar las deudas de las familias a través de Caixa. El costo de vida, las tasas de interés y el endeudamiento de las familias fueron algunos de los principales temas económicos del último debate entre los candidatos a la Presidencia antes de la segunda vuelta, prevista para el domingo 25. En el encuentro organizado por TV Globo el viernes por la noche, el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) discreparon sobre el papel del gasto público y del Banco Central. Sin embargo, ambos coincidieron en promesas como el ajuste del salario mínimo por encima de la inflación, una política que los economistas señalan como una de las fuentes de presión sobre las cuentas públicas por su impacto en el gasto previsional. VER MÁS: ¿Dónde invertir en Brasil? Goldman Sachs ve oportunidades tras el repunte electoral del 8,5% El encuentro se produjo con una contienda aún indefinida. En la encuesta de Datafolha publicada el jueves, ambos candidatos obtuvieron el 50% de los votos válidos. En la primera vuelta, Flávio consiguió el 47,03% de los votos válidos y Lula, el 45,16%. Fue el segundo enfrentamiento entre ambos, después del debate de Band del domingo. El debate tuvo cuatro bloques. En los tres primeros, con regiones sorteadas y temas elegidos por los candidatos, hubo espacio para propuestas sobre infraestructura, salud, educación y seguridad. El último bloque, de tema libre, estuvo ocupado en su mayor parte por acusaciones sobre patrimonio, pedidos de levantamiento del secreto bancario y fiscal, y vínculos con Banco Master. Flávio presentó la mayoría de las solicitudes de derecho a réplica a lo largo de la noche, y la producción rechazó la mayor parte. El debate se celebró en el tramo final de una campaña marcada por promesas que aumentan el gasto de ambos candidatos, con pocos detalles sobre cómo se financiarían. En varios momentos, Flávio se comprometió a mantener políticas del actual gobierno. Dijo que ajustará el salario mínimo y las jubilaciones por encima de la inflación, mantendrá el programa Pé-de-Meia y garantizará un aumento del beneficio de Bolsa Família. También manifestó su apoyo a la tarifa cero en el transporte público durante los fines de semana, una propuesta que Lula vincula con el fin de la jornada laboral de seis días de trabajo por uno de descanso (6x1), y afirmó que no privatizará Banco do Brasil, Caixa ni Petrobras. Lula sostuvo que, sin la política de valorización del salario mínimo aplicada por los gobiernos del PT, el piso salarial estaría hoy en 900 reales. La política monetaria fue uno de los principales puntos de divergencia. Flávio afirmó que la tasa Selic, actualmente en el 13,75% anual, es consecuencia de un “gobierno gastador”. Dijo que la deuda pública, de 11 billones de reales según él, cuesta casi 1 billón de reales al año en intereses. Según los datos del Banco Central, la deuda bruta del gobierno general sumaba 10,9 billones de reales en julio, equivalentes al 82,5% del PIB. Según el senador, en 2022 se proyectaba que la Selic estaría cerca del 7% en la actualidad si Jair Bolsonaro hubiera sido reelegido. Lula devolvió la pregunta y cuestionó por qué el grupo político de su adversario aprobó la autonomía del Banco Central. Flávio defendió la medida como una forma de impedir que un presidente reduzca las tasas de interés “de un plumazo” y mencionó a la Argentina durante los gobiernos de Cristina Kirchner y Alberto Fernández. Lula atribuyó el peso de la deuda al nivel de las tasas y defendió el crecimiento económico como vía para reducirla. “Toda vez que la economía no crece, aparece alguien hablando de recortar gastos, aplicar un tijeretazo o establecer un techo al gasto”, dijo Lula. “Cuanto más crezca la economía, más podremos reducir la deuda en relación con el PIB”. En una entrevista posterior al debate, Lula dijo que revisar la autonomía del Banco Central no es una prioridad de su programa y que confía en el presidente de la institución, Gabriel Galípolo. Atribuyó el nivel de las tasas de interés al tipo de cambio y a las guerras, y afirmó que el país paga un precio elevado para subsidiar los combustibles. “Lo que quiero es que el Banco Central baje las tasas de interés”, sostuvo. Flávio afirmó que las tasas de interés futuras cayeron después de la primera vuelta, cuando él quedó al frente. Según el senador, esto abriría un margen de más de 200.000 millones de reales en el presupuesto. Prometió utilizar parte de esos recursos para amortizar la deuda pública y comprarles a los bancos las deudas de las familias, para refinanciarlas a través de Caixa, a la que denominó “Banco de la Prosperidad”. Según la propuesta, las personas físicas pasarían seis meses sin pagar y las empresas, un año. “Voy a comprar su deuda a los bancos y la voy a refinanciar a través del Banco de la Prosperidad y de Caixa Econômica Federal”, dijo Flávio. Lula afirmó que su adversario está copiando un programa que el gobierno ya envió al Congreso. Según el presidente, una medida provisional contempla una subasta de deudas de las familias con los bancos durante este mes, con descuentos del 90% al 95%, por un monto que podría superar los 150.000 millones de reales. Mencionó las dos ediciones del programa Desenrola, que habrían beneficiado a unos 15 millones de personas, y la condonación de casi 15.000 millones de reales en deudas de microemprendedores individuales. Lula también defendió el fin de las apuestas online, a las que vinculó con el endeudamiento de las familias. Flávio criticó la carga tributaria y la reglamentación de la reforma tributaria. Dijo que la alícuota del nuevo impuesto al valor agregado (IVA) podría llegar al 28%, lo que, según él, lo convertiría en el más alto del mundo, y acusó al gobierno de crear o aumentar más de 30 impuestos. También afirmó que el gobierno gastó más de 400.000 millones de reales en medidas no contempladas en el presupuesto para buscar la reelección. Lula no respondió directamente a las críticas sobre el IVA. En el sector agropecuario, Flávio dijo que la tasa de interés real del crédito rural se acerca al 20% y prometió proteger el seguro rural y el Plan Safra de los recortes presupuestarios. Lula respondió que el crédito agrícola del BNDES y de Banco do Brasil está subsidiado y no sigue la Selic. También mencionó la apertura de 700 nuevos mercados para las exportaciones después de los aranceles impuestos por Estados Unidos. En materia de salud, Lula cuestionó el compromiso de su adversario con la financiación del Sistema Único de Salud (SUS). Flávio dijo que invertirá en el sistema, actualizará la tabla de pagos a médicos y hospitales y refinanciará las deudas de las Santas Casas a través de Caixa. En educación, Lula prometió alcanzar una cobertura del 100% de escuelas de jornada completa hasta la educación media y extender el programa Pé-de-Meia a la universidad. Flávio defendió la educación técnica en el turno contrario al de las clases regulares, una ayuda para el cuidado infantil con acceso a plazas en la red privada cuando falten vacantes públicas y asociaciones entre escuelas y empresas. En cuanto a la seguridad, Flávio prometió clasificar al PCC, al Comando Vermelho y a las milicias como organizaciones narcoterroristas, reducir la edad de imputabilidad penal y aumentar las penas por robo de teléfonos celulares. Lula dijo que, con la aprobación de la enmienda constitucional sobre seguridad, creará un ministerio dedicado al área y reforzará la Policía Federal y la Policía Federal de Carreteras. Sobre la Amazonía, Lula defendió la economía basada en mantener el bosque en pie y el Fondo Amazonía. En una entrevista posterior al debate, Flávio dijo que su programa prevé eliminar la deforestación ilegal para 2029, con participación de las Fuerzas Armadas. También defendió la explotación petrolera en el Margen Ecuatorial. VER MÁS: ¿Por qué Brasil se convirtió en una prioridad global para Roblox después de Estados Unidos? En sus consideraciones finales, Flávio pidió a los votantes que evaluaran si su vida había mejorado o empeorado en los últimos cuatro años y se comprometió a “devolverles su poder adquisitivo”. Lula pidió disculpas por el tono del debate y recordó su trayectoria, desde vendedor ambulante y tornero mecánico hasta llegar a la Presidencia. “Ustedes saben lo que hicimos juntos”, dijo antes de pedir el voto.

items.title: Reports: Michigan State QB Milivojevic out vs. No. 9 UCLA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Michigan State quarterback Alessio Milivojevic was ruled out of Saturday's road game against No. 9 UCLA with an undisclosed injury, multiple outlets reported.
items.body:
Michigan State quarterback Alessio Milivojevic was ruled out of Saturday's road game against No. 9 UCLA with an undisclosed injury, multiple outlets reported.
The injury leaves true freshman Kayd Coffman to start for the Spartans (2-5, 0-4 Big Ten), with backup QB Cam Fancher also out with an injury.
Coffman has appeared in one game this season, seeing mop-up duty in a 31-3 loss to Wisconsin on Oct. 3 when Fancher was injured. He did not attempt a pass in his brief appearance.
Milivojevic had been listed as questionable to play earlier this week as Michigan State rides a five-game losing streak heading into Saturday's game at Pasadena, Calif. In seven games this season, Milivojevic has completed 65.4% of his passes for 1,263 yards, seven touchdowns and three interceptions.
UCLA (6-0, 4-0) knows all about quarterback injuries. The Bruins lost starter Nico Iamaleava to a knee injury during an Oct. 10 victory at Oregon. Cal Poly transfer Ty Dieffenbach took over and finished off the victory over the Ducks then led the Bruins to a 17-7 victory over Wisconsin last week in his first career FBS start.
--Field Level Media

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: Orlando Magic star forward Paolo Banchero is nursing a low-grade high-ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday.
items.body:
Orlando Magic star forward Paolo Banchero is nursing a low-grade high-ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday.
The Magic did not disclose a recovery timetable, with ESPN reporting the injury diagnosis typically carries a timetable of four-to-six weeks.
Banchero sustained the injury during the third quarter of the Magic's 115-93 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday.
"Most of all my ankle sprains have always been to the outside, so this is kind of foreign to me," Banchero told the Orlando Sentinel. "So a little scary in that way."
Banchero, 23, has averaged 24.5 points, 7.5 assists and 6.5 rebounds in two games (both starts) this season.
The former No. 1 overall draft pick in 2022 has averaged 22.4 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists in 272 games (all starts) in five seasons for Orlando.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Hutíes afirman haber atacado instalaciones petroleras saudíes, se registran ataques en Yemen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los hutíes de Yemen afirmaron el sábado que lanzaron ataques contra instalaciones petroleras y aeropuertos de Arabia Saudita, mientras que la coalición liderada por el reino que combate al grupo dijo haber derribado dos misiles mientras se intensifican los enfrentamientos entre ambas partes.
items.body:
Los hutíes de Yemen afirmaron el sábado que lanzaron ataques contra instalaciones petroleras y aeropuertos de Arabia Saudita, mientras que la coalición liderada por el reino que combate al grupo dijo haber derribado dos misiles mientras se intensifican los enfrentamientos entre ambas partes.
En otro frente de un conflicto cada vez más intenso, reavivado por la guerra con Irán, el Gobierno yemení respaldado por Riad afirmó que los hutíes también lanzaron tres misiles balísticos contra instalaciones de la guardia costera en la ciudad portuaria de Adén, al sur de Yemen.
Las autoridades sauditas no confirmaron de inmediato las informaciones de los hutíes, y no quedó claro si los supuestos ataques habían alcanzado sus objetivos en el reino o habían sido interceptados.
El portavoz militar hutí, Yahya Saree, afirmó que el grupo había atacado el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid de Riad, una instalación de Aramco en Yanbu, la refinería de petróleo de Rabigh, estaciones de bombeo de crudo y el oleoducto Este-Oeste.
También señaló que el grupo había atacado el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Fahd de Dammam, un aeropuerto en Najran y una base aérea en Khamis Mushait.
La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita afirmó haber destruido el sábado dos misiles balísticos lanzados por los hutíes hacia Yanbu y Taif.
La reanudación de los combates ha hecho añicos la tregua de 2022 negociada por la ONU, que había frenado en gran medida los ataques transfronterizos entre la coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita y los hutíes, que controlan la capital, Saná.
La escalada ha abierto otro frente en la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán.
En Yemen, el Ministerio del Interior del Gobierno reconocido internacionalmente afirmó que dos de los misiles de los hutíes habían impactado en una sede de la guardia costera, mientras que un tercero alcanzó un edificio de la guardia costera en el distrito de Tawahi.
El portavoz hutí, Saree, afirmó que el grupo había atacado concentraciones militares respaldadas por Arabia Saudita en lo que denominó el campamento de Al-Nasr y una base naval en Adén, y señaló que oficiales sauditas supervisaban la movilización en esos lugares. La coalición no hizo ningún comentario sobre esa afirmación.

items.title: Irán ha intensificado esfuerzos para atacar a personal EEUU, advierte reporte de servicios inteligencia
items.author: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Irán ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense, y los complots letales de la república islámica contra sus ciudadanos han alcanzado "fases avanzadas", advirtió un alto cargo de los servicios de inteligencia de Washington en un memorándum al que Reuters tuvo acceso.
items.body:
Irán ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense, y los complots letales de la república islámica contra sus ciudadanos han alcanzado "fases avanzadas", advirtió un alto cargo de los servicios de inteligencia de Washington en un memorándum al que Reuters tuvo acceso.
La alerta del director de Inteligencia Nacional, Jay Clayton, se produjo después de que Washington redujera a principios de esta semana la plantilla de su misión en Arabia Saudita, en respuesta a la intensificación de los ataques por parte de las fuerzas hutíes, aliadas de Irán.
Esos ataques en uno de los frentes del conflicto regional, que dura ya casi ocho meses y que se desencadenó a raíz de la Guerra de Irán, han coincidido con un aumento de los ataques contra el transporte marítimo comercial en el estrecho de Ormuz.
A principios de este mes, fuentes informaron a Reuters que Irán estaba preparando una respuesta más contundente en caso de que Estados Unidos reanudara los ataques militares a gran escala contra su territorio.
"Concretamente, a través de diversos canales, hemos recibido información de inteligencia según la cual Irán ha intensificado considerablemente sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense", escribió Clayton al secretario de Estado Marco Rubio en un mensaje fechado el 23 de octubre.
"Los planes letales de los iraníes contra ciudadanos estadounidenses han alcanzado fases avanzadas tanto en Oriente Medio como en algunos otros países", añadió.
El Departamento de Estado ordenó el miércoles a los empleados públicos no esenciales y a sus familiares que abandonaran las misiones diplomáticas de EEUU en Arabia Saudita y tenía previsto retirar a los familiares de otras misiones de la región, informaron fuentes de Washington a Reuters.
El Departamento de Estado actualizó el sábado las advertencias de viaje para más de una docena de países del Golfo y Oriente Medio, entre ellos Arabia Saudita, Qatar, los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Irak e Israel, alegando una mayor amenaza por parte de los hutíes.
"La amenaza de ataques hutíes y de complots terroristas iraníes dirigidos contra funcionarios estadounidenses está determinando nuestras decisiones sobre los ajustes de personal en las embajadas que se encuentran en 'estado de operaciones restringidas' (ROE) en la región", dijo un funcionario estadounidense.
El ROE proporciona al Departamento de Estado mayor flexibilidad en las decisiones relativas al personal sin tener que anunciar públicamente un cambio en el estatus de una misión.

items.title: Nigeria's Tinubu launches re-election campaign as economic pain tests support
items.author: Camillus Eboh, Ben Ezeamalu
items.creator: Camillus Eboh, Ben Ezeamalu
items.summary: President Bola Tinubu formally launched his campaign for a second term on Saturday in the northern city of Kaduna, where he sought to convince voters that painful economic reforms are beginning to pay off despite a lingering cost-of-living crisis.
items.body:
President Bola Tinubu formally launched his campaign for a second term on Saturday in the northern city of Kaduna, where he sought to convince voters that painful economic reforms are beginning to pay off despite a lingering cost-of-living crisis.
Tinubu, 74, faces a contest ahead of a January 16 election that is likely to be dominated by the economy and security. His main challengers include former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi, who finished second and third respectively in 2023.
By midday, thousands of supporters of the president's All Progressives Congress party had filled much of the 10,000-capacity Ranchers Bees Stadium, with more arriving as the rally got underway.
"Thank you for this massive showing up. It is a promise. Come 2027, January 16, you must go out massively and elect me again," Tinubu told the crowd.
OPPOSITION CREATED PROBLEMS, SAYS TINUBU Since taking office in 2023, Tinubu has scrapped [USN:S8N36204O TEXT:"fuel subsidies"], devalued the [USN:S8N362046 TEXT:"naira"] and introduced other reforms credited with improving public finances, foreign reserves and investor sentiment. But the measures have also fuelled Nigeria's worst cost-of-living crisis in a generation.
Petrol prices rose to about 1,400 naira ($1.05) a litre in Lagos and Abuja in September and as much as 1,500 naira in parts of northern Nigeria, adding to pressure on household budgets.
Tinubu dismissed opposition complaints about hunger and poverty, arguing that his rivals created those problems.
"They created the hunger. They created the poverty. We are trying to eradicate it."
Phrank Shaibu, a spokesperson for the Atiku campaign, told Reuters the president was attempting to dodge responsibility.
"Mr President, blaming the opposition for hunger is either delusion or a staggering case of political amnesia," he said.
Security will provide [USN:L6N44N0Z4 TEXT:"another test"]. Nigeria continues to battle armed bandits and kidnappers in the northwest and a 17-year Islamist insurgency in the northeast, where militants have stepped up attacks on military positions.
Tinubu nevertheless enters the race with a formidable political machine. His camp says he has the backing of 32 of Nigeria's 36 state governors, potentially giving him an unprecedented organisational advantage, although past elections have shown governors cannot always deliver their states to presidential candidates.
His toughest electoral test could come in [USN:L6N434151 TEXT:"the north"], where Atiku, a veteran northern politician with an established support base, will seek to erode the president's vote.
Tinubu has said he will not attend campaign rallies in all 36 states as he needs to remain focused on governing. The party's proposed timetable has him personally attending rallies in 12 states, culminating in a major closing rally in his home state of Lagos on January 9.
($1 = 1,330.6400 naira)

items.title: Incêndio devasta antigo refúgio nazista "Ninho da Águia"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bombeiros trabalharam por horas para conter um incêndio que atingiu o refúgio nazista conhecido como "Ninho da Águia", no sul da Alemanha, enquanto a polícia investigava a causa do fogo após deter um homem nas proximidades do local, informaram as autoridades neste sábado.
items.body:
Bombeiros trabalharam por horas para conter um incêndio que atingiu o refúgio nazista conhecido como "Ninho da Águia", no sul da Alemanha, enquanto a polícia investigava a causa do fogo após deter um homem nas proximidades do local, informaram as autoridades neste sábado.
Cerca de 200 bombeiros e equipes de emergência na região de Berchtesgaden, no Estado da Baviera, combatiam as chamas após o edifício, conhecido como Kehlsteinhaus, pegar fogo na sexta-feira, segundo a polícia.
Construído em 1938 como casa de hóspedes para autoridades nazistas e seus convidados, o prédio está situado em um cenário alpino de destaque acima de Berchtesgaden. Adolf Hitler o utilizava ocasionalmente, o que lhe rendeu o apelido de "Casa de Chá de Hitler". O imóvel é separado da residência de verão de Hitler nas proximidades, o Berghof.
O jornal Bild citou um porta-voz da polícia dizendo que o edifício, preservado após a Segunda Guerra Mundial como monumento histórico ligado ao período nazista, sofreu danos tão graves que "provavelmente não poderá ser salvo".
A polícia informou anteriormente que havia detido um homem próximo ao local, mas ainda não havia determinado a causa do incêndio.
"A possibilidade de essa pessoa estar ligada ao incêndio é atualmente objeto de uma investigação criminal", informou a polícia da Baviera em comunicado.
(Reportagem de James Mackenzie)

items.title: Gabriel shines at both ends as Arsenal ease past Everton to go level with Man City
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Gabriel Magalhaes proved Arsenal's hero at both ends of the pitch on Saturday as the reigning champions beat Everton 2-0 to draw level with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.
items.body:
Gabriel Magalhaes proved Arsenal's hero at both ends of the pitch on Saturday as the reigning champions beat Everton 2-0 to draw level with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.
Making his 200th Premier League appearance, the centre back was instrumental in a victory that [USN:L2N46A02I TEXT:"put Arsenal level on 21 points with City"], the Brazilian combining defensive authority at the back with a decisive goal that put the result beyond doubt.
"He's one of the best centre backs in the world, no question, with the impact he has in both boxes," Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta said.
"His leadership, his presence, what he offers to the rest of the boys is unique and we're very happy to have him."
With his regular partner William Saliba still absent through injury, Gabriel's importance to Arsenal was underlined when Everton struggled to establish a foothold in the pouring rain at Emirates Stadium.
Gabriel consistently got the better of Everton striker Thierno Barry, who had a frustrating afternoon repeatedly ending up on the slick turf and pounding the ground in frustration after losing several duels with the defender.
Gabriel also came to Arsenal's rescue when goalkeeper David Raya failed to deal convincingly with an Everton corner in the first half, clearing the danger off the line to preserve the north London side's advantage.
There was a brief injury scare after an awkward landing when Gabriel jarred his knee on the turf, but he quickly returned to score the decisive second goal in the 68th minute.
After his centre back partner Ezri Konsa had opened the scoring from a corner in the seventh minute -- Arsenal's first set-piece goal since May -- Gabriel rose at the back post to meet Ben White's floated cross to head home their second.
"Gabi was unbelievable, the action that leads to the possible injury and then the way he overcomes that situation with his willingness to go again and to score that goal," Arteta added.
"It's a great description of what he is as a player and as a leader in this club."
It was Gabriel's 21st Premier League goal for Arsenal - more than any other defender since he made his debut in the competition six years ago.
"Very pleased for him. He's a top, top player. Top human being. Very happy for him," Konsa said.
"He's made my life easy since I've joined the club and it's been a pleasure playing alongside him."
items.raw_description: Gabriel Magalhaes proved Arsenal's hero at both ends of the pitch on Saturday as the reigning champions beat Everton 2-0 to draw level with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: The Cleveland Browns activated running back Dylan Sampson off injured reserve Saturday.
items.body:
The Cleveland Browns activated running back Dylan Sampson off injured reserve Saturday.
Sampson, who was placed on IR Sept. 15 with a knee injury, will not have an injury status for the Browns (4-2) in their game against the host Tennessee Titans (1-5) on Sunday in Nashville, Tenn.
Sampson, 22, was hurt returning a kickoff in the first quarter of Cleveland's 34-10 loss to the host Jacksonville Jaguars on Sept. 13.
He rushed 65 times for 175 yards and added 33 catches for 271 yards and two touchdowns in 15 games (two starts) during his rookie season last year. Sampson was selected by Cleveland in the fourth round of the 2025 NFL Draft out of University of Tennessee.
Also on Saturday, the Browns announced safety Grant Delpit has cleared concussion protocol and has no injury status for Sunday's game.
The team also placed guard Teven Jenkins (back) on injured reserve and elevated defensive tackle Sam Kamara from the practice squad.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Houthis dizem ter atacado instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos sauditas; coalizão afirma ter interceptado mísseis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, disseram que atacaram instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos da Arábia Saudita neste sábado, enquanto a coalizão liderada pelos sauditas que combate o grupo afirmou ter interceptado dois mísseis, à medida que os confrontos entre os dois lados se intensificam.
items.body:
Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, disseram que atacaram instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos da Arábia Saudita neste sábado, enquanto a coalizão liderada pelos sauditas que combate o grupo afirmou ter interceptado dois mísseis, à medida que os confrontos entre os dois lados se intensificam.
Em outra frente do conflito em escalada reavivado pela guerra envolvendo o Irã, o governo iemenita apoiado pela Arábia Saudita informou que os houthis também dispararam três mísseis balísticos contra instalações da guarda costeira na cidade portuária de Áden, no sul do país, sem relatos de vítimas.
Não houve confirmação imediata por parte das autoridades sauditas sobre os relatos, e não estava claro se os ataques reportados atingiram seus alvos no reino ou se foram interceptados.
O porta-voz militar houthi, Yahya Saree, afirmou que o grupo teve como alvo o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid, em Riad, uma instalação da Aramco em Yanbu, a refinaria de petróleo de Rabigh, estações de bombeamento de petróleo bruto e o oleoduto East-West.
Ele também disse que o grupo atacou o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Fahd, em Dammam, um aeroporto em Najran e uma base aérea em Khamis Mushait.
Mais cedo neste sábado, a Defesa Civil da Arábia Saudita emitiu brevemente alertas advertindo moradores sobre um possível perigo em Taif e Yanbu, bem como na cidade sagrada de Meca e em Jeddah, a segunda maior cidade do reino. Cerca de dez minutos depois, o órgão informou que a ameaça havia passado.
As interceptações ocorreram dois dias após os houthis afirmarem ter atacado o Ministério da Defesa saudita, em Riad, instalações da gigante petrolífera Saudi Aramco na cidade de Yanbu, às margens do Mar Vermelho, e o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Fahd, em Dammam, onde autoridades sauditas disseram que duas pessoas morreram.
A Aramco orientou funcionários a evacuarem sua sede na cidade de Dhahran, no Golfo, disseram à Reuters, na quinta-feira, seis fontes com conhecimento do assunto.
A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita informou na quinta-feira que interceptou drones sobre Riad e Medina, não muito longe de Yanbu. Na quarta-feira, os houthis negaram ter lançado drones em direção a Medina, após a coalizão afirmar que havia interceptado aeronaves não tripuladas sobre a cidade sagrada e sobre a Região Oriental da Arábia Saudita.
No Iêmen, o Ministério do Interior do governo internacionalmente reconhecido informou que os houthis dispararam três mísseis balísticos contra instalações da guarda costeira em Áden neste sábado. Dois mísseis atingiram o quartel-general da guarda costeira no complexo do ministério, enquanto um terceiro atingiu um edifício da guarda costeira no distrito de Tawahi, segundo o ministério.
Em comunicado separado, Saree afirmou que as forças houthis atacaram concentrações de tropas apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita no que chamou de Campo Al-Nasr e em uma base naval militar em Áden, alegando que oficiais sauditas supervisionavam a mobilização no local. A coalizão liderada pelos sauditas não comentou imediatamente a declaração.
Os houthis advertiram companhias aéreas no início deste mês a não utilizarem o espaço aéreo saudita, excetuando apenas o espaço aéreo sobre Meca e Medina, à medida que aumentavam os ataques contra o reino.
A retomada dos combates destruiu a trégua mediada pela ONU em 2022, que havia interrompido em grande medida os ataques transfronteiriços entre a coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita, que apoia o governo internacionalmente reconhecido do Iêmen, e os houthis, que controlam a capital Sanaa. A escalada abriu mais uma frente na guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra o Irã.
(Reportagem de Yasmine Ghania e Eman Abouhassira)

items.title: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks not spotted at practice
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles could be without star DeVonta Smith and fellow wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks for Monday's home game against the rival Dallas Cowboys.
items.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles could be without star DeVonta Smith and fellow wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks for Monday's home game against the rival Dallas Cowboys.
Smith (hamstring) and Wicks (ankle) were not spotted at the portion of practice open to the media on Saturday, but tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) was on the field. All three players did not participate in practice on Thursday or Friday.
Smith returned from a two-game absence last Sunday to record seven catches for 75 yards and a touchdown in Philadelphia's 25-14 loss to the Carolina Panthers.
He leads the team in both receptions (26) and receiving yards (310). He also has two touchdown catches in four games this season.
Wicks is second on the team in receptions (19) and receiving yards (284). He has one touchdown catch in six games this season.
Makai Lemon, Darius Cooper, Marquise "Hollywood" Brown, Elijah Moore and Britain Covey are the other receivers for the Eagles (2-4), who have lost four games in a row.
Tight end Zach Ertz is out of practice-squad elevations but could be signed to the active roster should Goedert be unable to play on Monday. Goedert has 17 catches for 180 yards and two touchdowns this season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Environ 1.200 Palestiniens déplacés à Hébron par une opération militaire israélienne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'armée israélienne a contraint environ 1.200 Palestiniens à quitter leurs foyers à Hébron, en Cisjordanie occupée, a déclaré samedi un responsable palestinien, au lendemain d'une attaque qui a coûté la vie à deux soldats israéliens.
items.body:
L'armée israélienne a contraint environ 1.200 Palestiniens à quitter leurs foyers à Hébron, en Cisjordanie occupée, a déclaré samedi un responsable palestinien, au lendemain d'une attaque qui a coûté la vie à deux soldats israéliens.
Le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu avait déclaré vendredi que l'armée lancerait une opération de grande envergure après la mort des soldats, tués lorsque deux Palestiniens ont ouvert le feu sur un poste de contrôle militaire près de la ville. Les deux assaillants ont été abattus.
L'armée a dit mener une opération dans deux quartiers qui jouxtent le poste de contrôle attaqué vendredi à la recherche de suspects et d'armes et pour y procéder à des destructions de bâtiments.
L'Autorité palestinienne a critiqué cette opération, la qualifiant de "punition collective".
Youssef Zouhair al Jabari, le maire de Hébron, a déclaré qu'environ 1.300 personnes risquaient de perdre leur logement, en plus des 1.200 déjà déplacées.
Il a ajouté que ces opérations israéliennes étaient motivées par les élections législatives de mardi, lors desquelles la coalition de droite de Benjamin Netanyahu pourrait perdre sa majorité, selon les sondages d'intention de vote.
"Netanyahu et les ministres extrémistes de son gouvernement tentent de remporter le plus grand nombre possible de voix parmi les colons", a-t-il dit.
Des habitants de Hébron ont déclaré à Reuters que l’armée avait expulsé de nombreuses personnes n’ayant aucun lien avec les assaillants palestiniens.
"Nous appelons les autorités à nous soutenir, car nous ne sommes impliqués dans rien de tout cela. Il y a des enfants. Nous sommes isolés ; nous ne faisons rien. Tout cela est arbitraire", a déclaré Majdi Nasser, l’un des habitants chassés de son domicile.
Dans toute la Cisjordanie, Israël a bloqué les accès à la plupart des villes et villages palestiniens, restreignant considérablement la liberté de circulation des habitants.

items.title: Steelers activate S DeShon Elliott from injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers safety DeShon Elliott returned to the active roster for the first time in 12 months on Saturday.
items.body:
Pittsburgh Steelers safety DeShon Elliott returned to the active roster for the first time in 12 months on Saturday.
Elliott, 29, was activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game in Paris against the New Orleans Saints.
Elliott is returning from a season-ending knee injury sustained in a Week 8 loss to Green Bay on Oct. 26, 2025.
He returned to practice on Oct. 8, opening a 21-day window either to return to the 53-man roster or miss the entire season.
A sixth-round draft pick by Baltimore in 2018, Elliott has recorded 433 tackles, 4.5 sacks, five interceptions and five fumble recoveries in 77 games (69 starts) with the Ravens (2019-21), Detroit Lions (2022), Miami Dolphins (2023) and Steelers.
The Steelers (4-2) also elevated wide receivers Brandon Johnson and Brandon Smith from the practice squad to the active roster for the game against the Saints (2-4).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Penguins place D Samuel Girard on injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed veteran defenseman Samuel Girard on injured reserve Saturday.
items.body:
The Pittsburgh Penguins placed veteran defenseman Samuel Girard on injured reserve Saturday.
Girard, 28, sustained a lower-body injury during a 6-2 road loss to the Vegas Golden Knights on Oct. 17.
He has one goal and six assists through nine games in his first full season with the Penguins, who acquired him in a Feb. 24 trade with the Colorado Avalanche.
A 2022 Stanley Cup champion with Colorado, Girard has posted 249 points (38 goals, 211 assists) in 617 games with the Nashville Predators, Avalanche and Penguins.
Pittsburgh recalled forward Avery Hayes, 24, from AHL affiliate Wilkes-Barre/Scranton in a corresponding transaction. He made his NHL debut with the Penguins last season and tallied five goals in 16 games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Albanian police fire tear gas as anti-government student protests turn violent
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Albanian riot police used tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets to disperse protesters who threw rocks at officers and started a fire at the door of the agriculture ministry in the capital, Tirana, on Saturday.
items.body:
Albanian riot police used tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets to disperse protesters who threw rocks at officers and started a fire at the door of the agriculture ministry in the capital, Tirana, on Saturday.
Student-led demonstrations, fuelled by anger over perceived government corruption, a lack of jobs and poor education standards, have engulfed central Tirana and spread to other cities this month.
Demonstrators demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama have set fire to government buildings as well as banks, smashed shop windows and pulled up paving stones to throw at police.
The unrest, which followed months of largely peaceful summer protests [USN:L6N42J18T TEXT:"against a luxury coastal development"] backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, poses the biggest challenge yet to Rama, who has governed since 2013 and won a fourth term in office last year.
The protesters gathered on Saturday around 2 p.m. (1200 GMT) in front of the education ministry, and threw stones and rocks at police.
The police pushed them away and they dispersed to several locations in the city.
"Albanians have woken up," said 28-year-old protester Daniel Tahiri, who described the government as a "dictatorship with the clothes of democracy."
Another protester, 29-year-old Orgeta Likaj, said people wanted Rama to know that Albanians no longer want him because of corruption and scandals.

items.title: Cerca de 1.200 palestinos são deslocados em Hebron com início de operação militar israelense
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O exército israelense obrigou cerca de 1.200 palestinos a deixarem suas casas em Hebron, na Cisjordânia ocupada, informou uma autoridade palestina neste sábado, um dia após um ataque palestino matar dois soldados israelenses.
items.body:
O exército israelense obrigou cerca de 1.200 palestinos a deixarem suas casas em Hebron, na Cisjordânia ocupada, informou uma autoridade palestina neste sábado, um dia após um ataque palestino matar dois soldados israelenses.
O primeiro-ministro de Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, havia anunciado na sexta-feira que os militares lançariam uma operação de grande escala após a morte dos soldados, atingidos quando dois homens armados palestinos abriram fogo contra um posto de controle militar próximo à cidade. O Exército israelense informou que os atiradores foram mortos.
Os militares também afirmaram que a operação nos bairros de Al-Jaladah e Ein Deir Baha, próximos ao posto de controle na entrada de Hebron, tinha como objetivo procurar militantes e armas. Em comunicado, disseram ainda que realizariam demolições.
A Autoridade Palestina criticou a operação, classificando-a como uma “punição coletiva”.
Yousef Zouhair Al-Jabari, chefe da prefeitura de Hebron, disse que cerca de 1.300 pessoas corriam o risco de perder suas casas, além das 1.200 já deslocadas.
Ele afirmou ainda que as operações israelenses foram motivadas pelas eleições parlamentares de terça-feira, nas quais a coalizão de direita de Netanyahu pode perder sua maioria, segundo pesquisas de opinião.
“Netanyahu e os ministros radicais de seu governo estão tentando conquistar o maior número possível de votos dos colonos”, disse Al-Jabari.
A organização não governamental Clube dos Prisioneiros Palestinos informou que as forças israelenses prenderam cerca de 70 palestinos na sexta-feira e no sábado. Autoridades israelenses não comentaram as supostas detenções.
ASSENTAMENTOS Al-Jabari afirmou que os militares demoliram lojas, fábricas, residências e estradas em Hebron e que a resposta foi desproporcional e injustificada.
Moradores de Hebron disseram à Reuters que os militares expulsaram muitas pessoas sem qualquer ligação com os autores do ataque palestino.
“Estamos pedindo às autoridades que nos apoiem porque não temos envolvimento algum com isso. Há crianças. Estamos isolados; não fazemos nada. Tudo isso é arbitrário”, disse Majdi Nasser, um dos moradores retirados de sua casa.
Moradores relataram à Reuters ter visto soldados israelenses marcando casas com um “X” preto após seus ocupantes palestinos terem sido forçados a sair. Não ficou imediatamente claro o significado da marcação.
O governo Netanyahu supervisionou uma rápida expansão dos assentamentos na Cisjordânia, considerados ilegais por órgãos da ONU e pela maioria dos países, embora Israel conteste essa avaliação.
Em toda a Cisjordânia, Israel bloqueou as entradas da maioria das cidades e vilas palestinas, restringindo severamente a liberdade de movimento dos palestinos.
Yousef Mur, morador da cidade palestina de Yatta, disse que os bloqueios o impediram de chegar a Jerusalém com sua filha para tratamento contra o câncer.
“A situação é ruim e estamos sofrendo. Quando tentamos atravessar, eles lançaram granadas de efeito moral em nossa direção, e minha filha ficou assustada no caminho. Lançaram granadas de efeito moral contra as pessoas. A situação é muito difícil”, afirmou Mur.
(Reportagem de Pesha Magid e Mussa Qawasma)
