items.title: Irã intensifica esforços para atacar cidadãos dos EUA, alerta memorando de inteligência
items.author: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.summary: O Irã intensificou os esforços para atingir cidadãos e funcionários dos Estados Unidos, e planos letais de Teerã contra norte-americanos chegaram a estágios “avançados”, alertou um alto funcionário de inteligência do governo Trump em um memorando obtido pela Reuters.
items.body:
O Irã intensificou os esforços para atingir cidadãos e funcionários dos Estados Unidos, e planos letais de Teerã contra norte-americanos chegaram a estágios “avançados”, alertou um alto funcionário de inteligência do governo Trump em um memorando obtido pela Reuters.
O alerta do diretor de Inteligência Nacional, Jay Clayton, foi emitido após Washington reduzir o quadro de funcionários de sua missão na Arábia Saudita nesta semana, em resposta à intensificação dos ataques das forças houthis aliadas do Irã.
Esses ataques, em uma das frentes do conflito regional que já dura quase oito meses e foi desencadeado pela guerra envolvendo o Irã, coincidiram com um aumento dos ataques contra embarcações comerciais no Estreito de Hormuz.
No início deste mês, fontes disseram à Reuters que o Irã estava preparando uma resposta mais contundente caso os Estados Unidos retomem ataques militares em larga escala contra seu território.
“Especificamente, por vários canais, recebemos informações de inteligência de que o Irã aumentou substancialmente os esforços para atingir funcionários norte-americanos”, escreveu Clayton ao secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, em mensagem datada de 23 de outubro.
“Os esforços iranianos para planejar ataques letais contra cidadãos dos EUA chegaram a estágios avançados tanto no Oriente Médio quanto em alguns outros países”, acrescentou.
O diretor da CIA, John Ratcliffe, também recebeu cópia do memorando não confidencial, inicialmente divulgado pelo Axios.
Na quarta-feira, o Departamento de Estado dos EUA determinou a retirada de funcionários governamentais não essenciais e de seus familiares das missões diplomáticas norte-americanas na Arábia Saudita e planejava retirar familiares de várias outras missões na região, disseram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters.
Neste sábado, o Departamento de Estado atualizou os alertas de viagem para mais de uma dezena de países do Golfo e do Oriente Médio, incluindo Arábia Saudita, Catar, Emirados Árabes Unidos, Iraque e Israel, citando o aumento da ameaça representada pelos houthis alinhados ao Irã.
“Quando se trata do pessoal em nossas embaixadas, avaliamos constantemente novas informações sobre o ambiente de segurança”, disse uma autoridade dos EUA.
“A ameaça de ataques dos houthis e de supostos complôs terroristas iranianos contra autoridades americanas está orientando nossas decisões sobre ajustes de pessoal em embaixadas que operam sob Status de Operações Restritas (RO Status) na região”, afirmou a autoridade.
O Status de Operações Restritas dá ao Departamento de Estado maior flexibilidade para tomar decisões sobre pessoal sem precisar anunciar publicamente uma mudança na condição operacional de uma missão diplomática.
A guerra envolvendo o Irã está a uma semana de entrar em seu nono mês e tem pressionado significativamente os índices de aprovação do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, às vésperas das eleições legislativas de meio de mandato, marcadas para 3 de novembro.
(Reportagem de Enas Alashray e Humeyra Pamuk)

items.title: イラン、米政府関係者狙う動き強化　殺害計画「進んだ段階」と米高官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Humeyra Pamuk　Enas Alashray

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Humeyra Pamuk　Enas Alashray

[２４日 ロイター] - クレイトン米国家情報長官は、イランが米政府関係者を標的とする動きを強めており、米国民殺害計画が「進んだ段階」に達していると警告した。クレイトン氏のメモをロイターが確認した。

米政府は今週、親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃激化を受け、サウジアラビアの在外公館の人員を縮小した。

クレイトン氏はルビオ国務長官に宛てた１０月２３日付のメモで「さまざまな経路を通じて、イランが米政府関係者を標的とする取り組みを大幅に強化しているとの情報を得た」とし、「イランによる米国民の殺害計画は、中東とその他の一部の国の双方で、進んだ段階に達している」とした。

このメモは機密扱いではなく、ラトクリフ中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）長官にも写しが送られていた。メモのことは、アクシオスが最初に報じた。

米当局者によると、国務省は２１日、サウジの在外公館に勤務する緊急対応要員以外の政府職員とその家族に国外退避を命じた。

米当局者は「大使館の人員配置については、治安環境に関する新たな情報を常に評価している」と述べた。「フーシ派による攻撃の脅威や、米政府当局者を標的としたイランのテロ計画が、中東地域で『業務制限（ＲＯ）』状態にある大使館の人員調整を判断する材料になっている」とした。

業務制限状態に指定すると、国務省は現地の安全状況に応じて在外公館のステータス変更を公表することなく、人員などをより柔軟に調整することができる。

国務省は２４日、フーシ派による脅威の高まりを理由に、サウジ、カタール、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）、イラク、イスラエルなど、湾岸・中東地域の十数カ国について渡航勧告を更新した。

items.title: Fármaco de Amgen combinado con inmunoterapia prolonga supervivencia en ensayo clínico sobre cáncer de pulmón
items.author: Deena Beasley
items.creator: Deena Beasley
items.summary: El fármaco Imdelltra de Amgen, en combinación con Imfinzi de AstraZeneca , redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 58% en comparación con la inmunoterapia de AstraZeneca utilizado en monoterapia en pacientes con cáncer de pulmón microcítico en estadio extenso, según los datos de un estudio presentado el sábado.
items.body:
El fármaco Imdelltra de Amgen, en combinación con Imfinzi de AstraZeneca (AZN.L) , redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 58% en comparación con la inmunoterapia de AstraZeneca utilizado en monoterapia en pacientes con cáncer de pulmón microcítico en estadio extenso, según los datos de un estudio presentado el sábado.
Imfinzi es actualmente el tratamiento de referencia tras la quimioterapia para los pacientes con esta enfermedad tan agresiva y difícil de tratar, cuyo cáncer no empeora tras la quimioterapia inicial.
El estudio reveló que los pacientes a los que se administraron ambos fármacos vivieron una mediana de 21,1 meses, frente a los 12,7 meses de los tratados únicamente con Imfinzi.
"Si se administra Imdelltra antes, se obtiene un mayor
beneficio clínico", afirmó Paul Burton, director médico de Amgen (AMGN.O) , quien calificó los resultados de "sin precedentes en el avance del tratamiento del cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en estadio extenso".
El fármaco de Amgen está actualmente autorizado para adultos en estadios avanzados de cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas que ha empeorado a pesar de la quimioterapia, basándose en datos que muestran que Imdelltra redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 40%.
Los resultados completos del ensayo, en el que participaron 563 pacientes, se presentaron en el congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica en Madrid y se publicaron en la revista "New England Journal of Medicine". Amgen ya había anunciado anteriormente que el estudio de fase III había tenido éxito.
Imdelltra pertenece a una clase de fármacos de doble diana denominados anticuerpos biespecíficos, diseñados para atraer a las células T del sistema inmunitario hacia las células cancerosas con el fin de destruirlas.
Imfinzi es un tipo más antiguo de inmunoterapia que, básicamente, bloquea el mecanismo que utilizan los tumores para esconderse del ataque del sistema inmunitario.
La mayoría de los casos de cáncer de pulmón son de células no pequeñas, mientras que hasta un 15% corresponde a la variedad de células pequeñas a la que se dirige Imdelltra.
Muy pocas personas diagnosticadas con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas son candidatas a cirugía, y a la mayoría se les administra inicialmente radioterapia y quimioterapia, explicó Burton.
Las tasas de supervivencia dependen del momento en que se diagnostica el cáncer, pero la tasa global a cinco años es solo de alrededor del 9%, según la Sociedad Americana contra el Cáncer.
Amgen señaló que, mientras continúa el seguimiento de los pacientes, casi el 80% de los participantes en el ensayo tratados con la combinación seguían vivos al cabo de un año, frente al 53% de los que recibían solo Imfinzi.
Se produjeron efectos secundarios graves, entre ellos un recuento bajo de glóbulos blancos, en el 20,9% de los pacientes que recibieron la terapia dual y en el 10,8% de los que recibieron la terapia en monoterapia.
Se notificó una afección potencialmente peligrosa conocida como síndrome de liberación de citocinas —una respuesta inflamatoria agresiva— en el 49,6% de los pacientes que recibieron Imdelltra. Sin embargo, solo un caso fue grave y no se produjeron fallecimientos relacionados con ese síndrome.

items.title: Libya's Dbeibah says ready to address Egypt's maritime concerns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The prime minister of Libya's UN-recognised Government of National Unity told Egypt's intelligence chief his government was ready to address Cairo's concerns over Mediterranean maritime boundaries and economic waters, his office said on Saturday.
items.body:
The prime minister of Libya's UN-recognised Government of National Unity told Egypt's intelligence chief his government was ready to address Cairo's concerns over Mediterranean maritime boundaries and economic waters, his office said on Saturday.
Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah and the intelligence chief Hassan Rashad discussed bilateral relations and coordination on matters of mutual interest during a phone call, the statement said
Egypt rejected on Wednesday a maritime boundaries agreement ratified by Libya's eastern-based parliament involving Turkey, saying the deal was null and void and would have no legal effect on Egypt
The Libya-Turkey maritime deal was [USN:KBN1Y21VL TEXT:"originally agreed"] in 2019 by Libya's internationally recognised government in Tripoli
The rival eastern administration, under military commander Khalifa Haftar, withheld its approval for years
The agreement is part of a long-running dispute over maritime claims and energy exploration rights in the eastern Mediterranean
Greece, Egypt and Cyprus have opposed the Libya-Turkey accord, saying it infringes their own maritime claims
Libya has been divided between Dbeibah's UN-recognised government in Tripoli and eastern authorities aligned with Haftar
Egypt and Libya, which share a land border, have longstanding security and economic ties

items.title: Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, intelligence memo warns
items.author: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached "advanced stages", a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters.
items.body:
Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached "advanced stages", a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters.
The alert from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton came after Washington scaled back staffing at its mission in Saudi Arabia earlier this week in response to intensified attacks by Iran-allied Houthi forces.
Those attacks on one front of the nearly eight-month-old regional conflict triggered by the Iran war have coincided with [USN:L8N4682UH TEXT:"a rise in attacks"] on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
Earlier this month, sources told Reuters Iran was preparing a [USN:L8N45M1N4 TEXT:"more forceful response"] if the United States resumes large-scale military attacks on its territory.
"Specifically, through various channels, we have received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target US personnel," Clayton wrote to US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in a message dated October 23.
"The lethal plotting efforts by the Iranians against US citizens have reached advanced stages in both the Middle East and certain other countries," he added.
CIA Director John Ratcliffe was also copied in on the unclassified memo which was first reported by Axios.
The State Department on Wednesday [USN:L6N46718Z TEXT:"ordered"] non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave US diplomatic missions in Saudi Arabia and planned to withdraw family members from a number of other missions in the region, US officials told Reuters.
On Saturday, the US State Department updated travel advisories for more than a dozen countries across the Gulf and Middle East, including Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq and Israel, citing an increased threat from Iran-aligned Houthis.
"When it comes to our staffing at embassies, we constantly evaluate new information about the security environment," a US official said.
"The threat of Houthi attacks and of Iranian terror plots targeting US officials are informing our decisions on staffing adjustments for embassies on RO Status in the region," the official said.
The Restricted Operations Status provides the State Department more flexibility in personnel decisions without having to publicly announce a change in the status of a mission.
The Iran war is a week away from entering its ninth month and has significantly weighed on the approval ratings of US President Donald Trump ahead of midterm elections on November 3.

items.title: 仏で厳戒の中デモ、警備7万人投入　地方で散発的衝突
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Juliette Jabkhiro　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Juliette Jabkhiro　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２４日 ロイター] - フランスの首都パリなどで２４日、生活費高騰などマクロン政権に抗議するデモが厳戒態勢の中で行われた。複数の都市で散発的な衝突が起きたものの、１週間前に比べて小規模だったとみられる。

政府は今回、警官と憲兵７万人を配置。全国的な抗議デモがここ数年で最悪級の混乱に発展した１０月１７日より１万人増員した。

警察によると、首都パリでは数万人が平和的に行進した。

一方、フランス第２、第３の都市であるマルセイユとリヨンでは、覆面をした若者らと警察の間で衝突が発生した。クレルモンフェラン、グルノーブル、リール、ニースでは警察がデモ隊に向けて催涙ガスを使用した。ニースではデモ隊が後退命令に従わなかったため、放水銃が投入された。

ヌニェス内相は、昼過ぎまでに全国で１３５人を逮捕したと説明した。その多くは事前の所持品検査を受けての逮捕で、花火やベアリングの鋼球など、武器として使われる恐れのある物が見つかったという。

パリの集会に参加した急進左派「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」と党首ジャンリュック・メランション氏は、「集団としての規律と自制を示す、見事な大衆の示威行動」だとたたえた。

メランション氏は、マクロン氏がフランスの社会不安に対処しない限り抗議デモは続くと述べた。「現状を考えれば、これが毎週繰り返されることを彼も理解するようになると思う。（マクロン氏が）譲歩する時間はまだある。それを過ぎれば、彼に残されるのは退場の道だけだ」と語った。

メランション氏は、今回の混乱をあおったと政府、中道左派から極右までの各会派から批判されている。

items.title: Beier sends Dortmund top as Leipzig rout Elversberg
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Maximilian Beier scored a superb winner as Borussia Dortmund went top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 home victory over Eintracht Frankfurt on Saturday, while RB Leipzig swept aside promoted Elversberg 4-0 after a rampant second-half display.
items.body:
Maximilian Beier scored a superb winner as Borussia Dortmund went top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 home victory over Eintracht Frankfurt on Saturday, while RB Leipzig swept aside promoted Elversberg 4-0 after a rampant second-half display.
Dortmund have 17 points from their seven matches, three points ahead of second-placed Bayern Munich, who have a game in hand and play on Sunday at Freiburg.
The home side had been frustrated until Beier picked up the ball on the edge of the box, made space for the shot and curled his effort into the far corner of the net.
The result ends a run of consecutive draws for Dortmund and is another clean sheet for a side who have conceded only four goals this season.
CARDOSO DOUBLE Romulo Cardoso scored twice for RB Leipzig in their thumping win, while Tidiam Gomis and Christoph Baumgartner, in his first Bundesliga game of the season after injury, were also on target.
Elversberg have acquitted themselves well in their maiden top-flight season but were well beaten.
Werder Bremen climbed to sixth with a 3-2 victory at Mainz as a pair of Niclas Fuellkrug penalties inside the opening 25 minutes gave them the perfect start.
Mainz pulled back a goal but Ludovit Reis made it 3-1 and despite the hosts netting again, Bremen were able to hold on for the win.
Fuellkrug took his tally of goals this season to eight and leads the scorers' charts in the Bundesliga having scored in his last six league matches.
Rayan Philippe netted a winning goal two minutes from the end as Paderborn moved out of the bottom three with a 1-0 win at home to Hamburg.
Philippe joined Paderborn on loan from Hamburg this season and came off the bench against his parent club, choosing not to celebrate despite the enormity of the goal for his side.
There was a goal and a red card each for Augsburg and Union Berlin as they drew 1-1.
Both teams were down to 10 men before the first goal was scored as Felix Uduokhai got his marching orders for Union and Juma Bah was sent off for the home side.
Han-Noah Massengo put the hosts ahead in the 71st minute but they had to settle for a point when Janik Haberer equalised for the visitors three minutes later.
Cologne and Schalke played out a 0-0 draw, a result that left Schalke in the bottom three.

items.title: Pakistan's LPG crisis deepens as prices hit 600 PKR/kg, hundreds of trucks stranded at Iran border
items.author: Prabhakar Jha
items.summary: Pakistan's LPG imports from Iran have halted after two key border crossings were closed, pushing up cylinder prices and raising fears of worsening shortages. Traders warn of further increases as hundreds of trucks remain stranded and both countries discuss resuming trade.
items.body: Pakistan is facing liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) shortages and rising prices after the closure of two border crossings with Iran disrupted supplies, Reuters reported.The Gabd-Rimdan and Taftan crossings were shut on October 17, with the two countries offering different explanations. Pakistan's Balochistan government cited security concerns and efforts to curb smuggling, while Iran's foreign ministry attributed the closure to technical issues.Pakistan imports around 7,000 metric tonnes of LPG daily from Iran, according to the Pakistan LPG Association. More than 4,000 tonnes of the daily supply passes through Gabd-Rimdan alone, said Shamsul Haq, former president of the Gwadar Chamber of Commerce and Industry."These imports are at halt," Haq told Reuters.The disruption has pushed up LPG prices within days. Traders said the price of a 12-kg cylinder had climbed to 7,000 Pakistani rupees ($25) from 4,500 rupees ($16), with further increases possible if supplies remain disrupted.LPG prices rise across PakistanThe impact of the supply disruption is already being felt across the country. Pakistan LPG Association Chairman Irfan Khokhar told Reuters that a 12-kg cylinder was selling for around 7,000 rupees in Balochistan, 7,500 rupees in Lahore and 8,200 rupees in Skardu.Khokhar warned that shortages and price increases could intensify. He also said higher LPG prices were contributing to increases in the cost of other goods.Farhat Abbas, a resident of Lahore, told Reuters that the price he paid for LPG had doubled or more since the crossings were closed. He previously paid 250 rupees per kg but was now paying between 500 and 600 rupees per kg.Consumers are concerned that the supply constraints could worsen as winter approaches, when demand for fuel may rise.Trucks stranded as trade comes under pressureThe border closures have also disrupted the movement of goods between the two countries. Haq said hundreds of trucks, including LPG tankers, were stranded on both sides of the border.More than 1,000 Pakistani containers carrying potatoes, bananas and rice destined for Iran were also held up, he said. The Gabd-Rimdan crossing reopened on Wednesday for Pakistani exports of perishable goods, although LPG imports remained halted, according to the report.The Quetta Chamber of Commerce and Industry has advised its members to suspend new orders from Iran until further notice.Truck drivers stranded at the crossings described waiting for days in difficult conditions, with limited access to basic amenities. One driver, Abdul Ghani Baloch, told Reuters he had been waiting for more than a week for the border to reopen.Pakistan and Iran discuss resuming tradeThe disruption comes as Pakistan and Iran maintain significant cross-border trade ties. Bilateral trade stood at around $2.8 billion in the 2023-24 fiscal year, including approximately $684 million in Pakistani exports, according to the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry.Pakistan's army chief visited Tehran this week to discuss the US-Iran war and also held discussions with Iranian leaders on border issues. Iran's foreign ministry said consultations on restarting trade were under way.
items.raw_description: Pakistan's LPG imports from Iran have halted after two key border crossings were closed, pushing up cylinder prices and raising fears of worsening shortages. Traders warn of further increases as hundreds of trucks remain stranded and both countries discuss resuming trade.

items.title: Belgian protesters and police skirmish at anti-government demonstrations in Brussels
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The clashes were smaller than those that took place last week in Belgium and France.
items.body:
Belgian police used tear gas and pepper spray as they clashed in Brussels on Saturday with anti-government demonstrators calling for better conditions in the education system, Reuters witnesses and Belgian media reported.
The clashes came after hundreds of mainly young protesters gathered in a continuation of [USN:L6N46303L TEXT:"rallies"] that have taken place in recent months, calling for more funding for education and accusing police of excessive violence.
The clashes were much smaller and less violent than those that took place last week in Belgium and — on a far larger scale — in [USN:L2N46A01A TEXT:"neighbouring France"].
In one incident in Brussels on Saturday, protesters ran and fell to the ground as police pursued them, with officers hitting and kicking one demonstrator, Reuters witnesses saw.
Protesters threw road signs and other items onto a pile of rental scooters and bicycles and attempted to set it on fire.
In another incident, police used tear gas to disperse a group of protesters, multiple Belgian media outlets reported.
Brussels police said in a statement at the end of the afternoon that no major incidents had taken place. They said they had taken measures "to guarantee the maintenance of public order and the security of everyone".
Police officers temporarily detained five people for disturbing public order and detained four more for possessing prohibited weapons and for inciting rioting, the statement said.

items.title: Accuser in Cornell rape allegations can stay anonymous, judge rules
items.author: Milana Vinn
items.creator: Milana Vinn
items.summary: The woman at the center of rape allegations against Cornell University students can keep using a pseudonym in her lawsuit, a judge ruled.
items.body:
The woman at the center of rape allegations against Cornell University students can keep using a pseudonym in her lawsuit, a judge ruled.
New York state Judge Phaedra Perry-Bond ruled on Friday that the accuser's privacy interests, particularly concerns for her safety, outweighed the need to publicly disclose her identity in court proceedings.
The woman, who alleges she was drugged and raped by Cornell University students in 2024, has been the [USN:L6N45Q09V TEXT:"target of threats"], her lawyer, Thomas Giuffra, said earlier this month.
Although the defendants in the lawsuit did not oppose the request for anonymity, Perry-Bond wrote that "some members of the public have made it their mission to try and identify Jane Doe."
The judge warned that "cyberstalking and engaging in or encouraging threats across state lines, whether it be of Jane Doe, of any of the named defendants, or their attorneys, can be considered a federal crime and perpetrators of those acts may be subjecting themselves to prosecution."
The woman, who was 20 at the time of the alleged gang rape, filed her suit on September 16, prompting prosecutors to reopen a criminal investigation they had initially closed without charges.

items.title: Report: Indiana RB Khobie Martin to return vs. Michigan
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indiana running back Khobie Martin is expected to return from a six-game absence and play against Michigan on Saturday afternoon, ESPN reported.
items.body:
Indiana running back Khobie Martin is expected to return from a six-game absence and play against Michigan on Saturday afternoon, ESPN reported.
Martin has been sidelined since sustaining a broken forearm in the Hoosiers' season-opening 52-16 victory over North Texas on Sept. 5. The junior did not record a carry in the game.
Martin rushed 78 times for 505 yards (6.5-yard average) and six touchdowns in 14 games as Indiana marched to an undefeated national championship season in 2025.
Turbo Richards leads Indiana (6-1, 3-1) this season with a Big Ten-best 643 rushing yards and six touchdowns. Lee Beebe Jr. has 575 yards and four scores on the ground.
Michigan (4-2, 1-2) and sixth-ranked Indiana are meeting in Ann Arbor, Mich.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ex-NBA G Malik Beasley negotiating plea in gambling case
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Malik Beasley's attorney says the former NBA guard is working on a plea deal in his federal betting and bribery case.
items.body:
Malik Beasley's attorney says the former NBA guard is working on a plea deal in his federal betting and bribery case.
Attorney Steve Haney told ESPN on Saturday that Beasley, 29, is negotiating with Department of Justice prosecutors and a decision is expected early next week. A recent notice posted on the court docket indicated that he intends to plead guilty, according to ESPN.
The U.S. Attorney's Office in the Eastern District of New York alleges that Beasley deliberately manipulated his statistics in at least four games to benefit gamblers while he was playing for the Milwaukee Bucks in 2023-24.
Beasley, who played for six teams in nine seasons in the NBA from 2016-25, was indicted on federal charges in June. He initially pleaded not guilty to all counts of bribery in sporting contests, wire fraud conspiracy, honest services wire fraud conspiracy and money laundering conspiracy.
The indictment alleges that Beasley lost millions of dollars gambling during his career and agreed to adjust his performance so his alleged co-conspirators could wager on his statistics.
Beasley, a first-round pick in the 2016 NBA Draft by Denver, earned nearly $60 million in his NBA career. He averaged 11.7 points in 578 games with the Nuggets, Minnesota Timberwolves, Utah Jazz, Los Angeles Lakers, Bucks and Detroit Pistons.
Former NBA player Ed Davis also was charged in the case and has pleaded not guilty.
--Field Level Media

items.body:
Ataques ucranianos provocaron el sábado cortes de electricidad en algunas zonas de Crimea y en las áreas del este y el sur de Ucrania controladas por Rusia, informó el Ministerio de Energía ruso.
Los ataques afectaron la infraestructura energética, lo que provocó cortes en algunas zonas de las regiones de Jersón, Zaporiyia, Donetsk y Lugansk, añadió.
El ministerio no precisó cuántas personas se habían visto afectadas en esas zonas y en la península de Crimea, que fue anexionada por Rusia en 2014.
El personal estaba trabajando para restablecer los servicios y se habían realizado cortes temporales de electricidad para mantener la estabilidad de la red, añadió.

items.title: China insta a EEUU a que frene ampliación propuesta de restricciones a la inversión en el extranjero
items.author: Eduardo Baptista
items.creator: Eduardo Baptista
items.summary: El Ministerio de Comercio chino instó el sábado a Estados Unidos a que dejara de ampliar las restricciones a las inversiones en China, alegando que una norma propuesta sobre tecnologías sensibles perturbaría las relaciones comerciales.
items.body:
El Ministerio de Comercio chino instó el sábado a Estados Unidos a que dejara de ampliar las restricciones a las inversiones en China, alegando que una norma propuesta sobre tecnologías sensibles perturbaría las relaciones comerciales.
El Departamento del Tesoro publicó el jueves una serie de propuestas para actualizar su programa de seguridad en materia de inversiones en el extranjero, añadiendo la biotecnología a los sectores restringidos y ampliando el alcance de la normativa a la informática de alto rendimiento y los sistemas hipersónicos.
El Ministerio de Comercio de Pekín afirmó en un comunicado que la propuesta amplía "de forma discriminatoria" las restricciones a las inversiones relacionadas con China e intensifica las limitaciones, añadiendo que se opone firmemente a la propuesta estadounidense y se reserva el derecho a adoptar contramedidas que no especificó.
Pekín también señaló que la propuesta dañaría las relaciones económicas bilaterales y era contraria al consenso alcanzado por los presidentes de ambos países, que se han reunido en dos ocasiones en los últimos seis meses.
El Tesoro ha declarado que las medidas, que no se limitan a China, buscan impedir que el capital estadounidense financie el desarrollo, por parte de adversarios extranjeros, de tecnologías estratégicas de doble uso que podrían amenazar la seguridad nacional.
El programa ya había restringido determinadas inversiones estadounidenses relacionadas con China en los ámbitos de los semiconductores, las tecnologías cuánticas y la inteligencia artificial.

items.title: Trump afirma que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca
items.author: Jason Lange
items.creator: Jason Lange
items.summary: El presidente Donald Trump confirmó el sábado que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca a otra ubicación.
items.body:
El presidente Donald Trump confirmó el sábado que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca a otra ubicación.
En una publicación en las redes sociales, Trump desmintió un reporte que señalaba que tenía previsto eliminar la sala de prensa de la Casa Blanca y restaurar una piscina histórica en ese mismo lugar, afirmando que nunca se le había "pasado por la cabeza hacer algo tan estúpido".
Sin embargo, señaló que podría reubicar al cuerpo de prensa de su ubicación actual en la Casa Blanca. "Quizá traslade a los de las noticias falsas a un lugar menos molesto", afirmó Trump.
El New York Times informó el martes que Trump había instado en agosto a la entonces secretaria de prensa Karoline Leavitt a trasladar las ruedas de prensa fuera de la sala de prensa James S. Brady de la Casa Blanca, aunque la idea nunca se llevó a cabo.
Según el reporte, el presidente dijo a sus asesores que preferiría disponer de una piscina terapéutica cubierta que se instaló en ese lugar durante la administración de Franklin D. Roosevelt. El Gobierno de Richard Nixon sustituyó la piscina por la sala de prensa.
Trump ha acusado con frecuencia a la prensa estadounidenses de informar de forma sesgada sobre su Gobierno.
Trump prohibió temporalmente el mes pasado el acceso a los terrenos de la Casa Blanca a periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico, y afirmó que otros medios podrían enfrentarse a restricciones similares.
La Casa Blanca restableció su acceso tras una orden de un juez federal que consideró que la medida era probablemente inconstitucional, aunque el Gobierno sigue impugnando el caso.

items.body:
El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva siguen prácticamente empatados de cara a la segunda vuelta electoral del domingo, reveló el sábado una encuesta de CNT/MDA.
El senador de derecha, hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, obtendría el 46,3% de los votos, frente al 45% de Lula, según la encuesta. La semana pasada, otro sondeo mostraba a Bolsonaro por delante de Lula con un 46,8% frente a un 45,9%.
MDA encuestó a 2.032 personas entre el 21 y el 23 de octubre. El margen de error es de +/-2,2 puntos porcentuales.

items.title: After 'everything went wrong,' Suns eager to make right vs. Warriors
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Suns and Golden State Warriors -- two teams in various stages of recovery -- will meet in Phoenix on Saturday, when one will break into the win column.
items.body:
The Suns and Golden State Warriors -- two teams in various stages of recovery -- will meet in Phoenix on Saturday, when one will break into the win column.
The Warriors collapsed late in a 111-108 loss to Memphis in their home opener Friday, giving up 17 straight points after De'Anthony Melton's 3-pointer gave them a 106-94 edge with 3:47 left.
"Everything went wrong," guard Stephen Curry said after the Warriors fell to 0-2 for the first time since 2020-21.
The Suns hit a similar roadblock in Portland on Wednesday, when they gave up the first 21 points in a 124-83 loss in the Trail Blazers' home opener.
"We just absolutely got blitzed," Suns coach Jordan Ott said.
Curry scored 24 points against the Grizzlies after finishing with 23 in a 127-105 loss at the Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday. But he has yet to find his range, going 12-of-30 from the field and 5-of-17 from 3-point range.
Before the Memphis game, Warriors coach Steve Kerr outlined a new substitution pattern for Curry as the team seeks to offset the loss of scoring big man Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed health issue) for the foreseeable future.
"He'll play the first seven or eight minutes in the first quarter and then come back at the top of the second for a shorter shift," Kerr said of Curry. "That's how we are starting this year, and we'll see how it goes. It's always flexible."
Curry played the first seven minutes of the first quarter Friday and played another seven, including the first 3 1/2 in the second quarter. He had 14 of his points in 15 second-half minutes.
The Suns, who eliminated the Warriors in the play-in round 111-96 on April 17, found no rhythm on either side of the ball in Portland. They trailed by as many as 52 points in that game.
They shot 35.7% from the field and were outrebounded 56-39. The Trail Blazers made 19 of 47 3-pointers and were in the penalty before the Suns made a field goal.
Devin Booker scored 23 points on 7-of-13 shooting, but Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green and newcomer Miles Bridges were a combined 11-of-34 from the floor. The Blazers led 43-12 after the first quarter.
"Everything went wrong," Booker said, echoing Curry. "We have a lot to learn from on tape. They were killing us with their pace. It's an uphill battle when you are down 30 points. You feel like every shot has to go in. We just have to get off to a better start."
Suns second-year center Khaman Maluach started Wednesday, although both Maluach and third-year player Oso Ighodaro likely are to share post minutes while Mark Williams (left shoulder) is out. Maluach had two points and six rebounds in 17 minutes.
"Throwing young guys into the fire ... that's what you see, and he'll learn from this," Ott said. "We need him. We need him to grow. He will continue to grow. We need him to take a step. He'll take steps."
Ighodaro left the Portland game in the first half with an apparent right hip injury and did not return. Off guard Luke Kennard (left knee) did not play against the Blazers. The status of each player for Saturday's game is unknown.
Warriors guard Brandin Podziemski and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 18 points against Memphis. Backup big man Charles Bassey (knee) missed his second straight game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Na véspera do 2º turno, Lula diz que povo assumiu responsabilidade por campanha
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) disse neste sábado que o povo assumiu a responsabilidade por sua campanha no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, marcado para o domingo, e mostrou convicção de que conquistará um quarto mandato presidencial quando a apuração dos votos for realizada.
items.body:
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) disse neste sábado que o povo assumiu a responsabilidade por sua campanha no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, marcado para o domingo, e mostrou convicção de que conquistará um quarto mandato presidencial quando a apuração dos votos for realizada.
Em declaração à imprensa antes de participar de evento de campanha em Copacabana, acompanhado por uma multidão, Lula também fez críticas ao senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), seu adversário, que terminou à frente no primeiro turno, realizado no dia 4 de outubro.
"Estou dizendo para vocês e podem anotar, amanhã eu serei eleito presidente da República outra vez", afirmou Lula aos jornalistas.
"O povo assumiu para si a responsabilidade de fazer a campanha. Hoje nós temos um exército de democratas neste país maior que o Exército chinês, maior que o Exército russo e maior que o Exército americano que é o Exército do Lula, que vai chegar a 13 milhões de soldados e soldadas amanhã", continuou.
"E vamos ganhar as eleições por uma simples razão: é verdade que o povo quer mudança, e o povo quer mudança para melhor, o povo quer mudança para frente. O povo não quer retroceder e não está longe da nossa memória o que aconteceu no mandato dessa gente nesse país", acrescentou.
Lula se referia ao canal de WhatsApp Exército do Lula, criado pelo deputado federal reeleito André Janones (Rede-MG), no qual o parlamentar passa a apoiadores "missões" para colocar Lula em destaque nas redes sociais e para fazer críticas a Flávio.
A fala de Lula sobre a participação popular no segundo turno da campanha vem depois de uma série de críticas à campanha petista no primeiro turno, de dentro e de fora do PT e inclusive do próprio Lula, que em reunião logo após a primeira rodada disse que a campanha até o dia 4 de outubro foi a [USN:L6N45T151 TEXT:""menos organizada""] de que participou desde 1989.
Após a passeata em Copacabana, Lula fará à tarde evento de campanha na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo. No domingo, a previsão é que vote logo cedo pela manhã em São Bernardo do Campo e acompanhe a apuração na capital paulista.
Flávio venceu o primeiro turno com 47,03% dos votos válidos contra 45,16% de Lula.
As pesquisas de intenção de voto têm mostrado empate técnico entre ambos, com vantagem numérica para o senador. Levantamento [USN:S0N46101Q TEXT:"CNT/MDA"] divulgado neste sábado mostrou Flávio com 46,3% dos votos totais contra 45% de Lula. Nos votos válidos, quando são excluídos brancos, nulos e indecisos, o senador tem 50,7% e o presidente soma 49,3%.

items.title: WTA roundup: No. 1 Elena Rybakina chasing 4th title of '26
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: World No. 1 Elena Rybakina will play for her fourth title of the season Sunday at the Ningbo Open in China, opposing Canada's Leylah Fernandez.
items.body:
World No. 1 Elena Rybakina will play for her fourth title of the season Sunday at the Ningbo Open in China, opposing Canada's Leylah Fernandez.
Both players posted 6-3, 7-5 victories on Saturday. Top-seeded Rybakina, from Kazakhstan, beat No. 6 Diana Shnaider of Russia and Fernandez topped Czech Marie Bouzkova.
Rybakina, who won the WTA 500 tournament last year, is seeking the first successful title defense of her career and her 15th career title. Fernandez has six career titles, winning in Singapore in September. Rybakina holds a 3-2 lead in their head-to-head series.
Japan Open
Ashlyn Krueger defeated fellow American and No. 1 seed Ann Li 6-4, 6-7 (4), 6-3 to earn a place in the finals in Osaka.
Li lost serve in the first game of the third set and could not catch up. Serving down 5-3 in the third, Li went up 40-0 and squandered the lead, with Krueger winning on her second match point.
Krueger won the title in Osaka in 2023 and is 10-2 in her career at the WTA 250 tournament. She will face Czech Katerina Siniakova, who defeated No. 8 Katie Boulter of Great Britain 6-1, 6-4 in the other semifinal.
--Field Level Media

items.body:
A Azul (AZUL3.SA) firmou uma operação de financiamento de até R$2 bilhões, com cobertura do risco de crédito concedida pela União, por intermédio da Agência Brasileira Gestora de Fundos Garantidores e Garantias (ABGF), com recursos do Fundo de Garantia à Exportação (FGE), conforme fato relevante da companhia aérea publicado neste sábado.
"Os recursos serão destinados exclusivamente ao pagamento de combustível de aviação adquirido para operação regular doméstica", informou a empresa, acrescentando que o financiamento está alinhado à estratégia de longo prazo da companhia e foi contemplado como parte de seu plano de reestruturação.
"A operação fortalece ainda mais a posição de liquidez da Azul e proporciona flexibilidade financeira adicional para atuar no atual cenário de volatilidade nos preços dos combustíveis. Somado ao caixa existente e a outras iniciativas de financiamento obtidas recentemente, o montante reforça a confiança da administração na estratégia da companhia e na posição de liquidez da Azul", acrescentou.

items.title: Trump diz que pode mudar equipe de imprensa da Casa Branca de lugar
items.author: Jason Lange
items.creator: Jason Lange
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local.
Em uma publicação nas redes sociais, Trump rejeitou uma reportagem segundo a qual ele planejava remover a sala de imprensa da Casa Branca e restaurar, no local, uma piscina histórica. Ele disse que nunca “sequer pensou em fazer uma coisa tão estúpida”.
No entanto, afirmou que poderia realocar o grupo de jornalistas de sua posição atual na Casa Branca.
“Posso mudar a Fake News para um local menos desagradável”, escreveu Trump na publicação.
O jornal The New York Times informou na terça-feira que Trump havia pedido à então secretária de imprensa Karoline Leavitt, em agosto, que transferisse as entrevistas coletivas para fora da Sala de Imprensa James S. Brady, na Casa Branca, mas a ideia nunca foi colocada em prática.
Segundo a reportagem, o presidente disse a assessores que preferiria uma piscina terapêutica coberta, instalada no local durante o governo de Franklin D. Roosevelt. A administração de Nixon substituiu a piscina pela sala de imprensa.
Trump tem acusado regularmente a mídia norte-americana de cobertura injusta de seu governo. No mês passado, ele baniu brevemente jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico das dependências da Casa Branca e disse que outros veículos poderiam enfrentar restrições semelhantes. Defensores da liberdade de expressão afirmaram que a medida violou as proteções da Primeira Emenda à liberdade de imprensa.
A Casa Branca restabeleceu o acesso desses jornalistas após uma ordem de um juiz federal, que considerou o banimento provavelmente inconstitucional, embora o governo Trump ainda conteste o caso.
(Reportagem de Jason Lange em Washington)

items.title: Amgen drug combined with immunotherapy extends survival in lung cancer trial
items.author: Deena Beasley
items.creator: Deena Beasley
items.summary: Amgen's Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday.
items.body:
Amgen's (AMGN.O) Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's (AZN.L) immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday.
Imfinzi is currently the standard of care following chemotherapy for patients with this very aggressive and hard-to-treat disease whose cancer does not worsen after initial chemotherapy.
The study found that those given both drugs lived for a median of 21.1 months, compared with 12.7 months for those treated only with Imfinzi.
"If you give Imdelltra earlier and earlier, you get bigger clinical benefit," said Paul Burton, chief medical officer at California-based Amgen. He called the results "unprecedented in advancing the treatment of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer."
Imdelltra's US list price is about $30,000 per cycle, or over $390,000 a year. Wall Street analysts have estimated annual sales reaching more than $2.5 billion by 2030, according to LSEG data.
The Amgen drug is currently [USN:L4N3HJ4BN TEXT:"approved for adults"] in the advanced stages of small cell lung cancer that has worsened despite chemotherapy, based on data showing that Imdelltra reduced the risk of death by [USN:L2N3S10O8 TEXT:"40%"].
Full results of the 563-patient trial were presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Amgen had previously announced that the Phase 3 study was [USN:L6N4500PD TEXT:"successful"].
Imdelltra belongs to a dual-target class of drugs called bispecific antibodies designed to pull immune system T cells into contact with cancer cells to destroy them. Imfinzi is an older type of immunotherapy that essentially blocks the mechanism tumors use to hide from immune-system assault.
Most lung cancer cases are non-small cell, while up to 15% are the small cell variety targeted by Imdelltra. About 250,000 new cases are diagnosed worldwide each year, according to the US National Institutes of Health.
Very few people diagnosed with small cell lung cancer are candidates for surgery, and most are initially given radiotherapy and chemotherapy, Burton said.
Survival rates depend on when the cancer is diagnosed, but the overall 5-year rate is only around 9%, according to the American Cancer Society.
Amgen said that nearly 80% of trial patients treated with the combination were alive after one year, compared with 53% of those on Imfinzi alone, as patient follow-up continues.
Serious side effects, including low white blood cell counts, occurred in 20.9% of patients on the dual therapy and 10.8% with the single therapy. A potentially dangerous condition known as cytokine release syndrome, an aggressive inflammatory response, was reported in 49.6% of patients who received Imdelltra. But only one case was serious and there were no CRS-related deaths.
Adverse events led to discontinuation of the combination therapy in 5.7% of trial patients and 5.8% of patients given only Imfinzi.
(This story has been corrected to say that median survival for trial patients is 21.1 months vs. 12.7 months, not 21.7 months vs. 12.1 months, in first bullet point.)

items.title: Rei da Jordânia ordena resposta com "mão de ferro" a ataque mortal à igreja
items.author: Abdelhadi Ramahi
items.creator: Abdelhadi Ramahi
items.summary: O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja.
items.body:
O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja.
Os agressores dispararam por vários minutos, em plena luz do dia, contra a igreja na província de Karak na sexta-feira, e também feriram 40 pessoas em um ataque raro contra a minoria cristã do país.
A segurança foi reforçada em shoppings, embaixadas estrangeiras e outros locais em todo o país, informou a embaixada dos Estados Unidos em Amã.
SENSAÇÃO DE PÂNICO Um padre descreveu como ele e outras pessoas mandaram que todos se deitassem no chão na igreja Greco-Ortodoxa São Jorge, a cerca de 120 km a sudoeste da capital, Amã. “Uma sensação de pânico tomou conta das pessoas presentes”, disse Theodoros Soueiss à Reuters. “Os disparos eram indiscriminados, e você nunca sabia onde uma bala poderia parar.”
O rei Abdullah condenou o “desprezível ato terrorista” durante uma reunião do Conselho de Segurança Nacional e afirmou que não há espaço para clemência quando se trata da vida dos jordanianos, informou a corte real.
Ataques como este são extremamente raros na Jordânia, um país relativamente estável no Oriente Médio, embora as autoridades afirmem ter frustrado vários complôs islamistas nos últimos anos.
Não houve reivindicação imediata de responsabilidade pelo ataque no reino, um importante parceiro dos EUA na luta contra grupos militantes. Autoridades disseram ser cedo para determinar se os atacantes tinham vínculos com grupos conhecidos dentro ou fora da Jordânia.
“Um massacre, um massacre em todos os sentidos da palavra”, disse Tarek Ammarin em um hospital onde os feridos estavam sendo atendidos. Um parente de Ammarin ficou ferido no ataque.
Os cristãos são minoria na população da Jordânia. O país abriga diversos sítios bíblicos que atraem peregrinos cristãos de todo o mundo.
A Jordânia está entre os aliados dos EUA no Oriente Médio que foram atingidos por ataques iranianos este ano, após os EUA e Israel lançarem ataques contra o Irã em fevereiro.
Bahjat al-Rushda, prefeito da vila de Shihan, em Karak, juntou-se a uma longa lista de autoridades que condenaram o que chamaram de ataque de extremistas terroristas. “Se Deus quiser, este país continuará seguro”, disse ele.
(Reportagem de Yasmine Ghania e Eman Abouhassira)

items.title: City boss Maresca rues costly errors as Villa inflict first league defeat
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest.
items.body:
Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest.
City arrived in Birmingham having won all seven of their league matches but a pair of defensive blunders gave Aston Villa their chances and they took both.
Marc Guehi's early miscontrol allowed John McGinn to set up Nicolas Jackson for the opening goal, while goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma allowed Jackson's low shot to squirm underneath him after the hour mark.
The result was particularly frustrating for City given the balance of play. They registered seven shots on target to Villa's two and repeatedly forced Zion Suzuki into action, but the Japan goalkeeper produced a string of excellent saves to preserve the hosts' lead.
There was at least one positive for City with Erling Haaland scoring on his return from a foot injury. The Norwegian had sat out Tuesday's 5-1 Champions League rout of AEK Athens but headed home from Iliman Ndiaye's cross for City's lone goal.
The afternoon belonged instead to Suzuki, who continued to justify Villa's faith since they signed him in August to replace the departed Emi Martinez. Time and again he denied City, frustrating Haaland and company as Villa claimed their fourth successive home league victory over the Blues.
Maresca was left to lament his side's wastefulness and the two avoidable goals that ultimately decided the match.
"Performance overall was good, amount of chances we created. "Absolutely, both (goals were avoidable). Sometimes you have to be a bit more lucky because we only conceded those two chances. But we created a lot of chances.
"We played most of the game in their box but you have to be clinical and avoid mistakes like the two goals we conceded."
For Villa, after a turbulent summer of arrivals and departures - including Martinez who went to Chelsea - there were finally signs that Unai Emery's rebuilt side are beginning to settle after a poor league start of three losses from their first four games.
"Today was a really good test, I was so excited for this test," Emery said. "Today is one step forward."
City have little time to dwell on the defeat, with back-to-back meetings against high-flying Brighton & Hove Albion next on the agenda, first in the League Cup fourth round on Wednesday and then in the Premier League next Saturday.
"A top team, another one," City defender Ruben Dias said. "A different way to play so we'll make the adaptation then focus on ourselves that's the main thing - our spirit, our will to win."

items.title: Rockets, Hawks vie to remain undefeated in new season
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks will try to start the year with three wins for the first time in six seasons on Saturday night when they face the Houston Rockets in Atlanta's home opener.
items.body:
The Atlanta Hawks will try to start the year with three wins for the first time in six seasons on Saturday night when they face the Houston Rockets in Atlanta's home opener.
The Hawks rolled over the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday and will try to go 3-0 for the first time since the 2020-21 team did it and ended up reaching the Eastern Conference final.
The Rockets also are undefeated, holding on to beat the San Antonio Spurs 114-110 on Friday. Houston hasn't started with three straight wins since 2017-18, the season the Rockets lost in the Western Conference final.
"We're excited," Atlanta's Jalen Johnson said. "We're excited to go play in front of our home crowd. We're looking to come out with the same energy on Saturday."
Atlanta has been scoring a lot of points -- an average of 130 in the first two games -- but has flourished because of its defense. Atlanta forced 14 turnovers and limited Charlotte to 43 points in the first half while taking a 68-43 halftime lead. The Hawks finished with 17 steals, created 25 turnovers and wound up setting a club record for the widest margin of victory (47 points).
"This game is just giving it to me, I'm not going to lie, I'm throwing it in my hands," said Atlanta's Dyson Daniels, who has 12 steals in two games. "I'm just trying to come out and be the best on defense and have that create our offense, so get out and run."
The Hawks have been led by Nickeil Alexander-Walker (an average of 22.5 points a game) and Johnson (19.5 ppg, 10.5 rebounds, seven assists) and newcomer Aaron Wiggins (17.5 ppg).
Houston, meanwhile, survived an intense battle on Friday with the rival Spurs. The key play came when 6-foot-7 Amen Thompson blocked 7-foot-4 Victor Wembanyama's potential game-tying drive to the basket with 0.6 seconds remaining.
"When Wemby caught the ball, I just thought he was going to be just tall and try to rise over the top -- and that's what he thought," Houston's Kevin Durant said. "But Amen is just a freak athlete. It's insane how he got up so quick to block that shot against the 7-4."
The Rockets had three players with 20-plus points against the Spurs: Alperen Sengun with 29, and Durant and Thompson with 20 apiece.
Durant has always been a matchup problem for the Hawks. In 34 career games against Atlanta, he is averaging 29.3 points, 6.8 rebounds and 4.7 assists a game. He scored 31 and 25 points against Atlanta last season.
"We can look at this and get some film from it and see how we can get better," Durant said. "We've got another game in Atlanta tomorrow, so we can hopefully build on this."
The Rockets won both games against the Hawks last season, prevailing by 18 and 22 points in a pair of non-competitive contests. Houston has won four games in a row against the Hawks, including the last two in Atlanta. The team will play again on Monday in Houston to complete the season series.
The Rockets plan to rest Fred VanVleet on Saturday. The veteran missed last season with right ACL surgery and will sit out the second night of Houston's back-to-back set because of load management; he played 31 minutes and scored 14 points against the Spurs.
Steven Adams (right calf) was able to play almost nine minutes on Friday after being listed as questionable.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Couche-Tard proposes up to $8 billion offer for Cumberland Farms, The Times reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard proposed an offer of $7.5 billion to $8 billion for US convenience store operator Cumberland Farms, formerly known as EG Group, Britain's Times newspaper reported on Saturday.
items.body:
Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard (ATD.TO) proposed an offer of $7.5 billion to $8 billion for US convenience store operator Cumberland Farms, formerly known as EG Group, Britain's Times newspaper reported on Saturday.
The offer would be lower than Cumberland Farms' $9 billion valuation target for a planned [USN:L4N43419C TEXT:"US IPO"], the report said
Couche-Tard and Cumberland Farms did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for a comment
Cumberland Farms remained committed to a US listing, the report said, citing people close to the company
The report also said Cumberland Farms had delayed its planned IPO after receiving takeover interest, including from infrastructure investor Stonepeak
A float is unlikely to take place before 2027 for Cumberland, the Financial Times reported earlier this month, citing people, although the company has not publicly given a timeline
Private equity firm TDR Capital owns 50% of Cumberland Farms, while British billionaire entrepreneurs, the Issa brothers, each hold 25%, the Times report said
Cumberland Farms operates more than 3,200 convenience stores and fuel stations across the US and Europe

items.title: Agha returns to Pakistan squad for Sri Lanka tests
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Pakistan Twenty20 captain Salman Ali Agha, who was among seven players released mid-series after the side lost two tests to England in August, has returned to the test squad for next month's two-match series with Sri Lanka at home, the Pakistan Cricket Board said on Saturday.
items.body:
Former Pakistan Twenty20 captain Salman Ali Agha, who was among seven players [USN:L6N44S0YO TEXT:"released mid-series"] after the side lost two tests to England in August, has returned to the test squad for next month's two-match series with Sri Lanka at home, the Pakistan Cricket Board said on Saturday.
Agha [USN:L6N45R0XG TEXT:"was removed"] as Pakistan's T20 captain and left out of this month's T20 series against Sri Lanka but the 32-year-old impressed in the One-Day Internationals, scoring a century against Sri Lanka last Sunday.
Left-arm spinner Ali Usman, who was also among the players released during the England tour, has been named in the 14-man squad as well, with the first test set to begin on November 9 at Rawalpindi.
Babar Azam will continue to lead Pakistan as they look to bounce back from a [USN:L6N45403K TEXT:"3-0 series loss"] in England.
However, the hosts have shaken up their batting line-up, calling up Sameer Minhas, Mohammad Taha and Mohammad Suleman for the first time. Shan Masood, who scored a fighting 95 against England in the third test last month, has been dropped.
Pakistan squad: Babar Azam (captain), Abdullah Fazal, Ali Usman, Arafat Minhas, Azan Awais, Mohammad Abbas, Mohammad Ghazi Ghori, Mohammad Suleman, Mohammad Taha, Razaullah, Saad Baig, Salman Ali Agha, Sameer Minhas, Saud Shakeel.

items.title: Flávio tem 46,3% e Lula soma 45% em empate técnico na véspera da eleição, diz CNT/MDA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estão em empate técnico na véspera do segundo turno da eleição presidencial que será realizado no domingo, mostrou pesquisa CNT/MDA divulgada neste sábado.
items.body:
O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estão em empate técnico na véspera do segundo turno da eleição presidencial que será realizado no domingo, mostrou pesquisa CNT/MDA divulgada neste sábado.
Segundo o levantamento, Flávio aparece numericamente à frente com 46,3% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula soma 45,0%. Na pesquisa anterior, divulgada em 16 de outubro, o senador aparecia com 46,8% e o presidente tinha 45,9%. O percentual dos eleitores que declarou voto branco ou nulo é de 5,8%, ante 4,9% na pesquisa anterior, enquanto os indecisos somam 2,9%, ante 2,4%.
Pelo critério de votos válidos, que exclui brancos, nulos e indecisos e é usado pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) na totalização dos votos, Flávio soma agora 50,7%, ante 50,5%, enquanto Lula tem 49,3%, ante 49,5%. Como a margem de erro é de 2,2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos, os dois estão em empate técnico a menos de 24 horas da abertura das seções eleitorais no domingo.
Para a pesquisa contratada pela Confederação Nacional do Transporte (CNT), o instituto MDA ouviu 2.032 pessoas entre quarta e sexta-feira.

items.author: Juliette Jabkhiro, Alessandro Parodi
items.creator: Juliette Jabkhiro, Alessandro Parodi
items.summary: Manifestantes se reuniram em Paris e em cidades de toda a França neste sábado, sob a vigilância de 70 mil policiais, enquanto o governo tentava evitar a repetição dos distúrbios e saques que sacudiram o país no fim de semana passado.
items.body:
Manifestantes se reuniram em Paris e em cidades de toda a França neste sábado, sob a vigilância de 70 mil policiais, enquanto o governo tentava evitar a repetição dos distúrbios e saques que sacudiram o país no fim de semana passado.
O ministro do Interior, Laurent Nuñez, disse que 135 pessoas haviam sido presas em todo o país até o início da tarde, muitas após revistas preventivas que encontraram fogos de artifício, rolamentos de esferas e outros objetos que poderiam ser usados como armas.
“Temos que ser extremamente ágeis. Recebemos muitos avisos sobre desordem, tanto de grupos políticos quanto, simplesmente, de criminosos”, disse aos jornalistas. “Vai ser um dia longo.”
Enquanto o início da principal marcha em Paris transcorria de forma pacífica, a polícia usou gás lacrimogêneo contra multidões em Lyon, a terceira maior cidade da França.
O governo mobilizou 10 mil policiais e gendarmes a mais do que em 17 de outubro, dia em que protestos contra o custo de vida e a deterioração dos serviços públicos se transformaram em alguns dos piores distúrbios que a França viu em anos.
LOJAS E MUSEUS FECHADOS Grande parte do centro de Paris parecia uma cidade em lockdown, com lojistas fechando as vitrines com tapumes, museus com as portas fechadas e mais de 20 estações de metrô interditadas.
Entidades empresariais pediram que os varejistas permanecessem fechados depois que milhares de lojas e negócios foram danificados ou saqueados em toda a França no fim de semana passado.
“Quase não há clientes, então não vale a pena ficar aberto”, disse Oskar, gerente de uma boutique Kiton em Paris.
Vários dos mais conhecidos centros culturais da capital, incluindo o Louvre, o Musée d’Orsay e a Ópera de Paris, fecharam como precaução, deixando os turistas frustrados.
“Está tudo fechado com tapumes e não sabemos bem para onde ir”, disse Xavier Dolliole, turista da cidade norte-americana de Nova Orleans.
A rota da principal manifestação em Paris só foi definida após uma batalha judicial, desencadeada por uma ordem policial de última hora que afastava os organizadores do centro da cidade em direção às regiões do sudeste da capital. A polícia argumentou que o trajeto original passava por áreas com alta concentração de empresas semelhantes às atacadas no fim de semana passado. Líderes de esquerda disseram que a mudança tardia tinha como objetivo causar confusão e afastar as pessoas.
“Mais uma vez, os que estão no poder criam transtornos para as marchas e prazos impossíveis para que as organizações se reorganizem”, disse o líder da esquerda radical Jean-Luc Mélenchon, que se juntou aos manifestantes nas ruas de Paris.
PARTIDO DE EXTREMA DIREITA REALIZA CONGRESSO Muitos manifestantes acusaram o governo de reagir de forma exagerada, com soldados enviados para patrulhar a Champs-Élysées. “Choramos pelas lojas, não pelas pessoas que são empobrecidas o ano todo”, disse Clara Lebbadi, estudante de artes de 22 anos.
“Minha amiga e eu quase não viemos porque estávamos com medo, mas viemos justamente porque é importante não deixar a repressão vencer”, acrescentou.
A primeira marcha autorizada neste sábado transcorreu pacificamente em Orléans, a cerca de 120 km ao sul de Paris, onde manifestantes protestaram contra o Reagrupamento Nacional, de Marine Le Pen, que realizava um congresso partidário na cidade.
As tensões aumentaram após tiros na sexta-feira a oeste de Paris, quando um atirador, suspeito de agir por ódio islamofóbico, matou uma pessoa e feriu outras quatro, entre elas uma menina de 12 anos.
“Viemos dizer à extrema direita, cara a cara, que não temos medo”, disse Bally Bagayoko, prefeito de Saint-Denis e membro do partido de esquerda radical França Insubmissa (LFI).
(Reportagem de Crispian Balmer, Bertrand Boucey, Alessandro Parodi, em Paris, e Elizabeth Pineau, em Orléans)

items.title: Adido do USDA prevê safra de soja brasileira de 184 mi t para 2026/27
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Agricultores brasileiros devem colher 184 milhões de toneladas de soja na safra 2026/27, segundo relatório divulgado na quinta-feira pelo adido do Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA, na sigla em inglês) em Brasília.
items.body:
Agricultores brasileiros devem colher 184 milhões de toneladas de soja na safra 2026/27, segundo relatório divulgado na quinta-feira pelo adido do Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA, na sigla em inglês) em Brasília.
A previsão não oficial no relatório do adido, divulgado pelo Serviço Agrícola Estrangeiro do USDA, está abaixo da projeção oficial do USDA para a safra brasileira de soja de 2026/27, de 186 milhões de toneladas.
Ainda assim, a previsão do adido representa um aumento de quase 2% em relação a 2025-26, quando o Brasil, maior produtor mundial de soja, produziu uma safra de 180,5 milhões de toneladas.
"As chuvas favoráveis no início da temporada têm apoiado o plantio nas principais regiões produtoras, mas a chuva persistente no Rio Grande do Sul e as previsões de tempo severo em vários estados podem prejudicar o desenvolvimento das safras", diz o relatório.
Segundo o texto, o adido prevê que as questões climáticas afetarão mais as operações de colheita do que o plantio.
"Apesar da expectativa de uma temporada de El Niño no Brasil, os produtores de soja permanecem otimistas, com a maioria das preocupações voltadas para as safras de milho e algodão da segunda temporada", diz o relatório.
A análise do adido projetou as exportações brasileiras de soja para 2026/27 em 117,5 milhões de toneladas, um aumento de 2,1% em relação a 2025/26, mas abaixo da previsão oficial do USDA de 118 milhões de toneladas.
(Reportagem de Julie Ingwersen em Chicago)

items.title: Flavio Bolsonaro, Lula about even ahead of Brazil election runoff, CNT/MDA poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva remain about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a CNT/MDA poll showed on Saturday.
items.body:
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva remain about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a CNT/MDA poll showed on Saturday.
The right-wing senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 46.3% of the vote compared with 45% for the leftist Lula, according to the poll. Last week, a poll showed Bolsonaro leading Lula 46.8% to 45.9%.
MDA surveyed 2,032 people from October 21 to October 23. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points.

items.title: France Jordan Bardella reconduit à la présidence du Rassemblement national
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Jordan Bardella a été reconduit samedi à la présidence du Rassemblement national, premier parti d'opposition de France, lors d'un congrès à Orléans (Loiret) où des personnalités de gauche ont participé de leur côté à une manifestation hostile à l'extrême droite.
items.body:
Jordan Bardella a été reconduit samedi à la présidence du Rassemblement national, premier parti d'opposition de France, lors d'un congrès à Orléans (Loiret) où des personnalités de gauche ont participé de leur côté à une manifestation hostile à l'extrême droite.
"Pour conduire Marine à l'Elysée, j'aurai besoin de vous", a dit devant plusieurs milliers de militants Jordan Bardella, qui s'est félicité d'avoir "multiplié par trois" (160.000) en quatre ans le nombre d'adhérents et il a salué les "70 maires et 3.000 conseillers municipaux" élus au printemps dernier.
Unique candidat à sa succession, l'eurodéputé est arrivé en 2022 à la tête du RN, fondé en 1972. Il prononcera dimanche un discours au Zenith d'Orléans, avant une prise de parole de Marine Le Pen, candidate à l'élection présidentielle.
Agé de 31 ans, Jordan Bardella est pressenti pour être Premier ministre si Marine Le Pen est élue présidente de la République au printemps prochain, ce que lui prédisent les plus récents sondages d'intentions de vote.
Le temps d'un week-end, la ville d'Orléans s'est transformée en symbole d'une France fracturée à six mois de l'échéance.
Dans la matinée de samedi, une manifestation réunissant 13.000 personnes - selon la préfecture - à l'appel d'un collectif d'organisations syndicales, associatives et politiques s'est élancée au départ du théâtre d'Orléans, éloigné du Zénith où s'est ouvert le congrès du RN à la mi-journée.
"GRANDE INQUIÉTUDE" La secrétaire générale de la CGT, Sophie Binet, le Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste, Olivier Faure, et le maire La France insoumise de Saint-Denis (Seine-Saint-Denis), Bally Bagayoko, ont participé à ce rassemblement sous haute protection policière.
"Macron démission, Le Pen en prison", ont scandé les manifestants. "Marianne, jamais Marine", "Le RN c'est la haine au service des ultra riches", pourrait-on lire sur les pancartes du défilé qui s'est déroulé en musique et sans incident.
"La montrée de l'extrême droite est une grande inquiétude" a dit à Reuters Benoît Réveillon, retraité orléanais se 63 ans. "Il y a d'autres alternatives. Éveillons nos consciences et proposons autre chose, pacifiquement".
Une autre manifestation contestataire prévue dimanche a été interdite par les autorités.
De l'autre côté de la Loire, à l'autre bout de la ville quasi déserte où de nombreux magasins avaient protégé leurs vitrines, plusieurs milliers d'élus, adhérents et sympathisants du Rassemblement national ont afflué au Zenith pour le 19e Congrès du RN.
"Marine, présidente", a lancé la salle, qui a chanté la Marseillaise et applaudi les forces de l'ordre déployées dans toute la France en cette journée de mobilisation contre la vie chère, notamment.
Un drapeau français sur le dos, Samantha Giroux, 39 ans, a dit à Reuters avoir "peur pour ses trois enfants" qu'elle élève à Troyes (Aube).
"Maintenant c'est des agressions pour une cigarette", déplore la militante, employée dans la cantine d'un lycée. "Et puis la France aux Français. Soit les étrangers vivent comme nous, si c'est pour foutre le bordel il repartent chez eux".
Venue de l'Essonne, Isabelle Fillien, 59 ans, regrette elle aussi "le bordel et l'insurrection partout". À la question de savoir si le RN est en mesure de gagner la présidentielle, elle reste prudente. "On a été déçus aux législatives. Il ne faut pas vendre la peau de l'ours."

items.title: How This County Made the Data Center Boom Pay Off
items.summary: AI is driving a wave of new data centers, but communities are increasingly asking what they get in return. Virginia’s Loudoun County turned the industry into a major tax base that helped fund schools, parks and infrastructure, yet even there, officials are now putting limits on further growth. The bigger lesson may be that towns have more bargaining power than they think. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Pelicans, Nuggets limp into first of two meetings in five days
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Playing at high altitude can be hard for visiting teams, and it's even tougher when it's the second game of a back-to-back set.
items.body:
Playing at high altitude can be hard for visiting teams, and it's even tougher when it's the second game of a back-to-back set.
That's what the New Orleans Pelicans will face when they visit the Denver Nuggets on Saturday night.
It will be the first of two games the teams will play against each other in the next five days, with the next matchup coming Wednesday in New Orleans.
The Pelicans could be without Yves Missi on Saturday after he suffered a left knee injury Friday night at Utah. Missi sustained the injury midway through the second quarter when teammate Zion Williamson landed on the leg following a shot attempt by Williamson.
"We're going to get a look at it (Saturday) in Denver," New Orleans coach Jamahl Mosley said of the injury.
The Pelicans are coming off a 120-119 loss vs. the Jazz and have to contend with a Nuggets team that lost its season opener at Oklahoma City on Thursday night. Denver scored just 84 points against the Thunder and already is dealing with an injury to the starting lineup.
Cam Johnson suffered an ankle injury late in the first half and didn't play in the second on Thursday. He was limping after the game but told The Denver Post he doesn't think it's a serious injury and he won't miss much time -- if any.
Without Johnson's ability to stretch defenses from deep, Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray were hounded by Oklahoma City, which held the Nuggets to 37.8% shooting from the field.
However, there were bright spots. Aaron Gordon looked strong, rookie Trevon Brazile had 12 rebounds in his NBA debut, and DeMar DeRozan looked comfortable in his first game with Denver.
Even if Johnson has to miss the home opener, the Nuggets hope to have Spencer Jones available fairly soon. Jones, who suffered a hamstring strain during the training camp, already has been ruled out for Saturday's game.
"It's not a serious thing, just precautionary," Denver coach David Adelman said Thursday night, per The Denver Post. But then he said: "It's one of those injuries that could turn out to be a serious thing."
The Pelicans still are looking for the first win for Mosley.
New Orleans trailed Utah by 10 at half, outscored the Jazz 38-24 in the third quarter and led by five in the fourth. The Pelicans fell behind by seven and rallied before Dejounte Murray missed a jumper at the buzzer that would have given them the road win.
"It's hard to win in this league," Williamson said. "If you want to win, you have to close games."
It would help if New Orleans could score more from deep. The Pelicans were 10-for-30 from 3-point range in a season-opening loss to Indiana on Wednesday and followed with an 8-for-26 effort Friday night.
Williamson missed his only attempt from deep after going 2-for-4 against the Pacers. He is looking for that shot after attempting only four in 2025-26.
"It was a good feeling," Williamson said. "It means a lot to see your work pay off."
--Field Level Media

items.title: US veteran Moltzan opens World Cup season with first career win
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Paula Moltzan started the World Cup Alpine ski season with a first career victory at the age of 32 on Saturday after US teammate Mikaela Shiffrin blew a giant slalom first-leg lead and finished seventh in the Austrian resort of Soelden.
items.body:
Paula Moltzan started the World Cup Alpine ski season with a first career victory at the age of 32 on Saturday after US teammate Mikaela Shiffrin blew a giant slalom first-leg lead and finished seventh in the Austrian resort of Soelden.
The 2026 Olympic team combined bronze medallist beat Italian-born Lara Colturi, who skis for Albania, by the slimmest of margins - 0.01 of a second after two runs down the Rettenbach glacier slope -- with Germany's Emma Aicher third.
The victory from fifth after the first run also made Moltzan the first woman to win with Van Deer skis, the brand founded by Austria's retired eight-times overall World Cup winner Marcel Hirscher.
"It feels like a fairytale right now," said the Minnesota-born skier.
"It doesn't really feel real but we've put in a lot of hard work this summer developing the ski and it feels like this is kind of a pinnacle, that it's paying off and we did all the right things. I can't imagine a better start."
The podium was the 11th of Moltzan's career, six of them second places including one in Soelden a year ago when Austrian [USN:L4N3W602Y TEXT:"Julia Scheib was a first-time winner."]
Scheib did not finish the first run this time.
World Cup overall champion Shiffrin led by 0.14 seconds after the first run, with Sweden's Sara Hector second and Switzerland's Camille Rast third, but conditions changed for the later starters in the second leg with falling snow, flat light and grey skies.
The 31-year-old US great, chasing a record-extending 111th World Cup win, has not won a giant slalom since December 2023 but has [USN:L8N45S1IB TEXT:"shifted her focus"] this season towards that discipline and super-G, and will race fewer slaloms.
Saturday's race also marked the World Cup return of Slovakian Petra Vlhova, who had been out injured since January 2024. The 2022 Olympic slalom champion and 2021 overall World Cup winner finished 23rd.
Italian Federica Brignone, the [USN:L8N3ZB04X TEXT:"Olympic champion"] in giant slalom and super-G on home snow in Cortina in February, was absent as she continues her recovery from surgery in August.

items.summary: The Chinese commerce ministry urged the United States on Saturday to stop expanding restrictions on American investments in China, saying a proposed rule on sensitive technologies would disrupt trade ties.
items.body:
The Chinese commerce ministry urged the United States on Saturday to stop expanding restrictions on American investments in China, saying a proposed rule on sensitive technologies would disrupt trade ties.
The US Treasury Department [USN:L1N46814W TEXT:"issued proposals"] on Thursday to update its outbound-investment security programme, adding biotechnology to restricted sectors and expanding coverage of high-performance computing and hypersonic systems.
Beijing's commerce ministry said in a statement that the proposal "discriminatorily" widened China-related investment restrictions and intensified curbs.
It firmly opposed the US proposal and reserved the right to take unspecified countermeasures, it added.
Beijing also said the proposal would damage bilateral economic ties and ran counter to the consensus reached by the countries' presidents, who have [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"met twice"] in the past six months.
The US Treasury has said the measures, which do not only cover China, are intended to stop US capital from supporting foreign adversaries' development of dual-use strategic technologies that could threaten US national security.
The US programme had already restricted certain US investments involving China in semiconductors, quantum technologies and artificial intelligence.

items.title: Train hits minibus in Russia's Far East, killing six
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Six people were killed and one person was injured when a train collided with a minibus in Russia's Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, local railway authorities said.
items.body:
Six people were killed and one person was injured when a train collided with a minibus in Russia's Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, local railway authorities said.
According to railway officials, the minibus attempted to cross the tracks at a level crossing despite a red signal and was struck by a passenger train bound for the city of Blagoveshchensk.
All the victims were in the minibus. The train's passengers and crew were not hurt.
The state-run RIA news agency, citing regional prosecutors, reported that all the minibus occupants were foreign nationals, but did not specify their nationalities.
